examples.x: You can't fool him—he's always quick on the draw.

senses.definition_vi: nhanh chóng hiểu hoặc phản ứng trong một tình huống mới

senses.definition: to be quick at pulling out a gun in order to shoot it
senses.definition_vi: nhanh chóng rút súng để bắn

senses.definition: full of rapid action and sudden changes

examples.x: In his latest movie, the action is fast and furious.

senses.definition_vi: đầy hành động nhanh chóng và thay đổi đột ngột

senses.definition: a person who can talk very quickly and easily, but who cannot always be trusted

examples.x: As a politician, she had the reputation for being a real fast talker.

senses.definition_vi: một người có thể nói rất nhanh và dễ dàng, nhưng không phải lúc nào cũng đáng tin cậy

senses.definition: a person who knows how to get what they want quickly, especially when beginning a sexual relationship with somebody
senses.definition_vi: một người biết cách đạt được điều mình muốn một cách nhanh chóng, đặc biệt là khi bắt đầu mối quan hệ tình dục với ai đó

senses.definition: that cannot be changed in any circumstances

examples.x: There are no hard and fast rules about this.
This situation isn’t hard and fast.

senses.definition_vi: không thể thay đổi trong bất kỳ hoàn cảnh nào

senses.definition: to earn money quickly and easily

examples.x: This is a long-term project. We are not out to make a quick buck.

senses.definition_vi: kiếm tiền nhanh chóng và dễ dàng

senses.definition: to trick somebody
senses.definition_vi: lừa ai đó

senses.definition: quickly

examples.x: Don't drive so fast!
How fast were you going?
I can't go any faster.
The water was rising fast.
Her heart beat faster.
Night was fast approaching.
He came round the corner blindingly fast.
By a few easy steps you can make your PC run faster.

senses.definition_vi: nhanh chóng

senses.definition: in a short time; without delay

examples.x: Children grow up so fast these days.
The series is fast becoming one of the most popular TV shows in the country.
The police said that they had reacted as fast as they could.
Ben knew he had to move fast.
The economy was expected to grow significantly faster than it did.

senses.definition_vi: trong một thời gian ngắn; không chậm trễ

senses.definition: doing the thing mentioned quickly

examples.x: a fast-flowing stream
fast-growing crops
a fast-moving detective story

senses.definition_vi: thực hiện việc được đề cập một cách nhanh chóng

senses.definition: completely

examples.x: Within a few minutes she was fast asleep (= sleeping deeply).
The boat was stuck fast (= unable to move) in the mud.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn toàn

senses.definition: as quickly as you can
senses.definition_vi: nhanh nhất có thể

senses.definition: to be disappearing quickly

examples.x: Hopes of a peace settlement were fading fast.

senses.definition_vi: biến mất nhanh chóng

senses.definition: to continue to believe in an idea, etc. despite difficulties
senses.definition_vi: tiếp tục tin tưởng vào một ý tưởng, v.v. bất chấp khó khăn

senses.definition: to treat somebody/something in a way that shows that you feel no responsibility or respect for them
senses.definition_vi: đối xử với ai đó/điều gì đó theo cách thể hiện sự thiếu trách nhiệm hoặc tôn trọng đối với họ

senses.definition: to refuse to move back; to refuse to change your opinions
senses.definition_vi: từ chối lùi lại; từ chối thay đổi ý kiến

senses.definition: quickly and in large quantities

examples.x: Questions were coming at them thick and fast.

senses.definition_vi: nhanh chóng và với số lượng lớn

senses.definition: to close or join together the two parts of something; to become closed or joined together

examples.x: Fasten your seat belts, please.
Emma shivered and fastened the top button of her coat.
He fastened up his coat and hurried out.
The garment is fastened with a sash.
The dress fastens at the back.
a short yellow skirt which fastens up the side.
The gown fastens down the front with Velcro.

senses.definition_vi: đóng hoặc nối hai phần của vật gì đó lại với nhau; được đóng hoặc nối lại với nhau

senses.definition: to close something so that it will not open; to be closed in this way

examples.x: Fasten the gates securely so that they do not blow open.
Make sure all the exits are securely fastened.
The window wouldn't fasten.

senses.definition_vi: đóng một vật gì đó để nó không mở ra; được đóng theo cách này

senses.definition: to fix something in a particular position

examples.x: He fastened back the shutters.
Use the special kit provided to fasten the child seat in the car.
A gold locket was fastened around Eleanor's neck.
Each bundle of 100 votes was rolled up and fastened with a rubber band.

senses.definition_vi: cố định một vật gì đó ở một vị trí cụ thể

senses.definition: to attach or tie one thing to another thing

examples.x: He fastened the papers together with a paper clip.
She fastened the rope to a tree.

senses.definition_vi: gắn hoặc buộc một thứ này vào một thứ khác

senses.definition: if you fasten your arms around somebody, your teeth into something, etc., or if your arms, teeth, etc. fasten around, into, etc. somebody/something, you hold the person/thing strongly with your arms, etc.

examples.x: The dog fastened its teeth in his leg.
His hand fastened on her arm.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn vòng tay ôm chặt ai đó, cắn chặt vào thứ gì đó, v.v., hoặc nếu vòng tay, răng, v.v. của bạn ôm chặt, cắn chặt vào ai đó/điều gì đó, bạn giữ người đó/vật đó mạnh mẽ bằng vòng tay, v.v.

senses.definition: if you fasten your eyes on somebody/something or your eyes fasten on somebody/something, you look at them for a long time

examples.x: He fastened his gaze on her face.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nhìn chằm chằm vào ai đó/điều gì đó hoặc mắt bạn nhìn chằm chằm vào ai đó/điều gì đó, bạn nhìn họ trong một thời gian dài

senses.definition: having too much flesh on it and weighing too much

examples.x: a fat dog
You'll get fat if you eat so much chocolate.
He grew fatter and fatter.
Do these jeans make me look fat?

senses.definition_vi: có quá nhiều thịt và quá cân

senses.definition: containing a lot of fat

examples.x: fat bacon/sausages

senses.definition_vi: chứa nhiều chất béo

senses.definition: thick or wide

examples.x: a fat volume on American history
a big fat envelope stuffed with banknotes

senses.definition_vi: dày hoặc rộng

senses.definition: large in quantity; worth a lot of money

examples.x: a fat sum/profit
He gave me a nice fat cheque.

senses.short_meaning_vi: số lượng lớn, giá trị cao
senses.definition_vi: lớn về số lượng; có giá trị nhiều tiền

senses.definition: used for saying that you do not believe something is likely to happen

examples.x: ‘They might let us in without tickets.’ ‘Fat chance of that!’
Fat chance of him helping you!

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn không tin điều gì đó có khả năng xảy ra

senses.definition: not at all good or useful

examples.x: Paul can't drive so he was a fat lot of use when I broke my arm.

senses.definition_vi: không tốt hoặc không hữu ích chút nào

senses.definition: used for saying that a situation may still change, for example that a contest, election, etc. is not finished yet, and somebody still has a chance to win it
senses.short_meaning_vi: tình hình có thể thay đổi
senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng một tình huống có thể vẫn thay đổi, ví dụ như một cuộc thi, bầu cử, v.v. chưa kết thúc và ai đó vẫn còn cơ hội chiến thắng

senses.definition: a white or yellow substance in the bodies of animals and humans, stored under the skin

examples.x: excess body fat
This ham has too much fat on it.
Exercise helps you burn off excess fat.

senses.definition_vi: một chất màu trắng hoặc vàng trong cơ thể động vật và con người, được lưu trữ dưới da

senses.definition: a solid or liquid substance from animals or plants, treated so that it becomes pure for use in cooking

examples.x: Cook the meat in shallow fat.

senses.definition_vi: một chất rắn hoặc lỏng từ động vật hoặc thực vật, được xử lý để trở nên tinh khiết để sử dụng trong nấu ăn

senses.definition: animal and vegetable fats, when you are thinking of them as part of what a person eats

examples.x: You should cut down on fats and carbohydrates.
Stick to foods that are low in fat.
Is your diet high in fat?
reduced-fat margarines

senses.definition_vi: chất béo động vật và thực vật, khi bạn coi chúng là một phần của những gì một người ăn

senses.definition: to have a long friendly talk with somebody about something

examples.x: Randall stayed chewing the fat for a while.
They met up once a year to chew the fat about the old days.

senses.definition_vi: có một cuộc trò chuyện thân mật dài với ai đó về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to have enough money to be able to afford expensive things, food, drink, etc.
senses.definition_vi: có đủ tiền để chi trả cho những thứ đắt tiền, thức ăn, đồ uống, v.v.

senses.definition: causing or ending in death

examples.x: a fatal accident/blow/illness
a potentially fatal form of cancer
If she gets ill again it could prove fatal.

senses.definition_vi: gây ra hoặc dẫn đến tử vong

senses.definition: causing disaster or failure

examples.x: a fatal error/mistake
Any delay would be fatal.
There was a fatal flaw in the plan.
It'd be fatal to try and stop them now.

senses.definition_vi: gây ra tai họa hoặc thất bại

senses.definition: the things, especially bad things, that will happen or have happened to somebody/something

examples.x: The fate of the three men is unknown.
She sat outside, waiting to find out her fate.
The court will decide our fate/fates.
Each of the managers suffered the same fate.
He warned about the scam so others could avoid a similar fate.
Inhabitants of war-torn areas have been abandoned to their fate.
From that moment our fate was sealed (= our future was decided).

senses.definition_vi: những điều, đặc biệt là những điều tồi tệ, sẽ xảy ra hoặc đã xảy ra với ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: the power that is believed to control everything that happens and that cannot be stopped or changed

examples.x: Fate was kind to me that day.
By a strange twist of fate, Andy and I were on the same plane.

senses.definition_vi: quyền lực được tin là kiểm soát mọi thứ xảy ra và không thể bị ngăn chặn hoặc thay đổi

senses.definition: a terrible thing that could happen

examples.x: At the last minute she was saved from a fate worse than death.

senses.definition_vi: một điều tồi tệ có thể xảy ra

senses.definition: to do something too confidently in a way that might mean that your good luck will come to an end

examples.x: She felt it would be tempting fate to try the difficult climb a second time.
It would be tempting fate to say that we will definitely win the game.

senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó quá tự tin theo cách có thể có nghĩa là may mắn của bạn sẽ kết thúc

senses.definition: a male parent of a child or an animal; a person who is acting as the father to a child

examples.x: My father died in 2017.
Ben's a wonderful father.
Our new boss is a father of three (= he has three children).
You've been like a father to me.
He was a wonderful father to both his natural and adopted children.
I never met my biological father.
Father, I cannot lie to you.

senses.definition_vi: cha ruột của một đứa trẻ hoặc động vật; một người đóng vai trò làm cha đối với một đứa trẻ

senses.definition: a person’s ancestors (= people who are related to you who lived in the past)

examples.x: the land of our fathers

senses.definition_vi: tổ tiên của một người (= những người có liên quan đến bạn đã sống trong quá khứ)

senses.definition: the first man to introduce a new way of thinking about something or of doing something

examples.x: Henry Moore is considered to be the father of modern British sculpture.

senses.definition_vi: người đàn ông đầu tiên giới thiệu một cách suy nghĩ mới về điều gì đó hoặc một cách làm việc mới về điều gì đó

senses.definition: used by Christians to refer to God

examples.x: Father, forgive us.
God the Father

senses.definition_vi: được người Cơ đốc giáo dùng để chỉ Chúa

senses.definition: the title of a priest, especially in the Roman Catholic Church and the Orthodox Church

examples.x: Father Dominic

senses.definition_vi: danh xưng của một linh mục, đặc biệt là trong Giáo hội Công giáo La Mã và Giáo hội Chính thống giáo.

senses.definition: from one generation of a family to the next
senses.definition_vi: từ thế hệ này sang thế hệ khác trong một gia đình.

senses.definition: used to say that a son’s character or behaviour is similar to that of his father
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng tính cách hoặc hành vi của con trai giống với cha của mình.

senses.definition: very much older than somebody (especially used to suggest that a romantic or sexual relationship between the two people is not appropriate)
senses.definition_vi: lớn tuổi hơn nhiều so với ai đó (đặc biệt được sử dụng để gợi ý rằng mối quan hệ lãng mạn hoặc tình dục giữa hai người là không phù hợp).

senses.definition: we believe a thing because we want it to be true
senses.definition_vi: chúng ta tin một điều gì đó vì chúng ta muốn nó trở thành sự thật.

senses.definition: the responsibility for something wrong that has happened or been done

examples.x: Why should I say sorry when it's not my fault?
It's nobody's fault.
He believes that the product’s poor image is partly the fault of the press.
It was his fault that we were late.
It's your own fault for being careless.
He would not admit fault for the collision.
I think the owners are at fault (= responsible) for not warning us.
Many people live in poverty through no fault of their own.

senses.definition_vi: trách nhiệm đối với điều gì đó sai trái đã xảy ra hoặc đã được thực hiện.

senses.definition: a bad or weak aspect of somebody’s character

examples.x: He's proud of his children and blind to their faults.
I love her for all her faults (= in spite of them).
I think my worst fault is impatience.

senses.definition_vi: một khía cạnh xấu hoặc yếu trong tính cách của ai đó.

senses.definition: something that is wrong or not perfect; something that is wrong with a machine or system that stops it from working correctly

examples.x: The book's virtues far outweigh its faults.
a mechanical/technical fault
The fire was caused by an electrical fault.
The system, for all its faults, is the best available at the moment.
a major fault in the design
We're trying to correct the faults in the program.
a common fault with this type of machine
The film is not without fault.

senses.definition_vi: điều gì đó sai hoặc không hoàn hảo; điều gì đó sai với một cỗ máy hoặc hệ thống khiến nó không hoạt động đúng.

senses.definition: a mistake made when serving

examples.x: He has served a number of double faults in this set.
Even tennis champions sometimes serve double faults.

senses.definition_vi: một lỗi được thực hiện khi giao bóng.

senses.definition: a place where there is a break that is longer than usual in the layers of rock in the earth’s crust

examples.x: the San Andreas fault
a fault line

senses.definition_vi: một nơi có vết nứt dài hơn bình thường trong các lớp đá của vỏ trái đất.

senses.definition: to look for and discover mistakes in somebody/something; to complain about somebody/something

examples.x: My mother did nothing but find fault with my manners.
My boss finds fault with everything I do.

senses.definition_vi: tìm kiếm và phát hiện lỗi ở ai đó/điều gì đó; phàn nàn về ai đó/điều gì đó.

senses.definition: used to say that somebody has a lot, or even too much, of a particular good quality

examples.x: She is generous to a fault.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng ai đó có rất nhiều, hoặc thậm chí quá nhiều, phẩm chất tốt nhất định.

senses.definition: a thing that you do to help somebody

examples.x: Could you do me a favour and pick up Sam from school today?
Can I ask a favour?
I would never ask for any favours from her.
I'll ask Steve to take it. He owes me a favour.
Thanks for helping me out. I'll return the favour (= help you because you have helped me) some time.
I'm going as a favour to Ann, not because I want to.
Do yourself a favour (= help yourself) and wear a helmet on the bike.

senses.definition_vi: một điều bạn làm để giúp đỡ ai đó.

senses.definition: approval or support for somebody/something

examples.x: Artists sought the favour of wealthy patrons.
The suggestion to close the road has found favour with (= been supported by) local people.
to gain/win/lose favour with somebody
The programme has lost favour with viewers recently.
The policy is gaining favour among voters.
She's not in favour with (= supported or liked by) the media just now.
It seems Tim is back in favour with the boss (= the boss likes him again).
Reality TV has begun to fall out of favour with viewers.
an athlete who fell from favour after a drugs scandal
The government looks with favour upon (= approves of) the report's recommendations.

senses.definition_vi: sự chấp thuận hoặc ủng hộ đối với ai đó/điều gì đó.

senses.definition: treatment that is generous to one person or group in a way that seems unfair to others

examples.x: As an examiner, she showed no favour to any candidate.

senses.definition_vi: sự đối xử hào phóng với một người hoặc nhóm theo cách có vẻ không công bằng với những người khác.

senses.definition: a small gift given to children at a party
senses.definition_vi: một món quà nhỏ được tặng cho trẻ em trong một bữa tiệc.

senses.definition: agreement to have sex with somebody

examples.x: demands for sexual favours

senses.definition_vi: sự đồng ý quan hệ tình dục với ai đó.

senses.definition: you are likely to succeed because the conditions are good and you have an advantage
senses.definition_vi: bạn có khả năng thành công vì các điều kiện thuận lợi và bạn có lợi thế.

senses.definition: to try to get somebody to like or support you by praising or helping them a lot

examples.x: He’s always trying to curry favour with the boss.
She tried to curry favour with the teachers.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng khiến ai đó thích hoặc ủng hộ bạn bằng cách khen ngợi hoặc giúp đỡ họ rất nhiều.

senses.definition: used in reply to a question that you think is silly

examples.x: ‘Do you think they'll win?’ ‘Do me a favour! They haven't got a single decent player.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để trả lời một câu hỏi mà bạn cho là ngớ ngẩn.

senses.definition: to do something that is not helpful to somebody or that gives a bad impression of them

examples.x: You're not doing yourself any favours, working for nothing.
The orchestra did Beethoven no favours.

senses.definition_vi: làm một việc gì đó không hữu ích cho ai đó hoặc gây ấn tượng xấu về họ.

senses.definition: if you are in favour of somebody/something, you support and agree with them/it

examples.x: He argued in favour of a strike.
There were 247 votes in favour (of the motion) and 152 against.
I'm all in favour of (= completely support) equal pay for equal work.
Most of the ‘don't knows’ in the opinion polls came down in favour of (= eventually chose to support) the Democrats.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn ủng hộ ai đó/điều gì đó, bạn ủng hộ và đồng ý với họ/nó.

senses.definition: in exchange for another thing (because the other thing is better or you want it more)

examples.x: He abandoned teaching in favour of a career as a musician.
Early in his musical career he abandoned blues in favour of jazz.

senses.definition_vi: đổi lấy một thứ khác (vì thứ kia tốt hơn hoặc bạn muốn nó hơn).

senses.definition: if something is in somebody’s favour, it gives them an advantage or helps them

examples.x: The exchange rate is in our favour at the moment.
She was willing to bend the rules in Mary's favour.
The golf tournament went in the Americans' favour.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một điều gì đó có lợi cho ai đó, nó mang lại cho họ lợi thế hoặc giúp đỡ họ.

senses.definition: a decision or judgement that is in somebody’s favour benefits that person or says that they were right

examples.x: The court decided in Ms Smith’s favour and she received compensation for unfair dismissal.
The High Court found in favour of the plaintiffs.

senses.definition_vi: một quyết định hoặc phán quyết có lợi cho ai đó mang lại lợi ích cho người đó hoặc nói rằng họ đã đúng.

senses.definition: in a fair way

examples.x: They undertook to make their judgement without fear or favour.

senses.definition_vi: một cách công bằng.

senses.definition: to prefer one system, plan, way of doing something, etc. to another

examples.x: Many countries favour a presidential system of government.
It’s a resort favoured by families with young children.
Another solution, which I strongly favour, is lower taxes for everyone.
With make-up I favour a minimalist approach.
She favours hugs over handshakes.
Most patients favour seeing the same GP for all their health needs.

senses.definition_vi: thích một hệ thống, kế hoạch, cách làm việc, v.v. hơn một cái khác.

senses.definition: to treat one person, group or organization better than you treat others, especially in an unfair way

examples.x: The treaty seems to favour the US.
My parents always favoured my older brother.
He favoured some individuals at the expense of others.
News coverage should not favour one party over another.

senses.definition_vi: đối xử với một người, nhóm hoặc tổ chức tốt hơn bạn đối xử với những người khác, đặc biệt là một cách không công bằng.

senses.definition: to provide suitable conditions for a particular person, group, etc.

examples.x: The warm climate favours many types of tropical plants.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp các điều kiện phù hợp cho một người, nhóm, v.v. cụ thể.

senses.definition: to look like one of your parents or older relations

examples.x: She definitely favours her father.

senses.definition_vi: trông giống một trong những cha mẹ hoặc người thân lớn tuổi của bạn.

senses.definition: to be expected to achieve something, especially in a competition

examples.x: He is favoured to win a third Olympic gold medal.

senses.definition_vi: được kỳ vọng đạt được điều gì đó, đặc biệt là trong một cuộc thi.

senses.definition: making people have a good opinion of somebody/something

examples.x: She made a favourable impression in the interview.
The biography shows him in a favourable light.
She gained a highly favourable impression of the company.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho mọi người có ấn tượng tốt về ai đó/điều gì đó.

senses.definition: positive and showing your good opinion of somebody/something

examples.x: The performance drew a lot of favourable comments from reviewers.
Reviews of the book have been favourable.
His proposals met with a broadly favourable response.

senses.definition_vi: tích cực và thể hiện ý kiến tốt của bạn về ai đó/điều gì đó.

senses.definition: expressing your agreement; giving permission

examples.x: Their demands received a favourable response.

senses.definition_vi: bày tỏ sự đồng ý của bạn; cho phép.

senses.definition: good for something and making it likely to be successful or have an advantage

examples.x: favourable economic conditions
An area with a favourable climate will inevitably be richer than one without.
The terms of the agreement are favourable to both sides.
The weather was favourable for a barbecue outside.

senses.definition_vi: tốt cho một cái gì đó và làm cho nó có khả năng thành công hoặc có lợi thế.

senses.definition: fairly good and not too expensive

examples.x: They offered me a loan on very favourable terms.
terms that could hardly be considered favourable

senses.definition_vi: khá tốt và không quá đắt.

senses.definition: blowing in the direction of travel

examples.x: They could not sail without a favourable wind.
These plans will need a favourable economic wind.

senses.definition_vi: thổi theo hướng di chuyển.

senses.definition: liked more than others of the same kind

examples.x: It's one of my favourite movies.
What is your all-time favourite song?
Who is your favourite writer?
January is my least favourite month.

senses.definition_vi: được yêu thích hơn những thứ khác cùng loại.

senses.definition: a performer, politician, sports player, etc., who is popular where they were born
senses.definition_vi: một nghệ sĩ biểu diễn, chính trị gia, vận động viên, v.v., người nổi tiếng ở nơi họ sinh ra.

senses.definition: (in the US) a candidate for president who is supported by his or her own state in the first part of a campaign
senses.definition_vi: (ở Mỹ) một ứng cử viên tổng thống được ủng hộ bởi chính bang của mình trong giai đoạn đầu của chiến dịch.

senses.definition: a person or thing that you like more than the others of the same type

examples.x: Which one's your favourite?
The band played all my old favourites.
One of my personal favourites is a movie that should please every age group.
This song is a particular favourite of mine.
The programme has become a firm favourite with young people.
These biscuits are great favourites with the children.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật mà bạn thích hơn những người hoặc vật khác cùng loại.

senses.definition: a person who is liked better by somebody and receives better treatment than others

examples.x: She loved all her grandchildren but Ann was her favourite.
Parents should never have favourites.
She was an extremely good student and a great favourite with the nuns.
He is a favourite among his teammates.

senses.definition_vi: một người được ai đó yêu thích hơn và nhận được sự đối xử tốt hơn những người khác.

senses.definition: a record of a section of an app or the address of a website that enables you to find it quickly

examples.x: Add the website as a favourite.
Have you added this website to your favourites list?
I've added the sports section to my favourites.

senses.definition_vi: một bản ghi về một phần của ứng dụng hoặc địa chỉ của một trang web cho phép bạn tìm thấy nó một cách nhanh chóng.

senses.definition: the horse, runner, team, etc. that is expected to win

examples.x: The favourite came third.
Her horse is the hot favourite for the race.
The Brazilians still look firm favourites to take the title.

senses.definition_vi: con ngựa, vận động viên, đội, v.v. được kỳ vọng sẽ thắng.

senses.definition: the person who is expected by most people to get a particular job or position

examples.x: She's the favourite for the job.
She's the favourite to succeed him as leader.

senses.definition_vi: người được hầu hết mọi người kỳ vọng sẽ có được một công việc hoặc vị trí cụ thể.

senses.definition: the bad feeling that you have when you are in danger or when a particular thing frightens you

examples.x: Her eyes showed no fear.
The child was shaking with fear.
I suddenly felt gripped by fear.
We were living in a perpetual state of fear and anxiety.
The attacks created a climate of fear.
Terror attacks are a tool to instil fear in the public.
He managed to overcome his fears.
Fear of crime can affect people's lives.
We lived in constant fear of losing our jobs.
Women should be able to work without fear of harassment.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác tồi tệ mà bạn có khi gặp nguy hiểm hoặc khi một điều gì đó cụ thể làm bạn sợ hãi.

senses.definition: a feeling of concern about somebody's safety or about something bad that might happen

examples.x: The doctor's report confirmed our worst fears.
Police tried hard to allay the fears of local residents.
her fears for her son’s safety
Alan spoke of his fears for the future.
the fear that he had cancer
The announcement sparked fears that interest rates will rise.
The government announced the new measures amid growing security fears.

senses.definition_vi: một cảm giác lo ngại về sự an toàn của ai đó hoặc về điều gì đó tồi tệ có thể xảy ra.

senses.definition: to avoid the danger of something happening

examples.x: We spoke quietly for fear of waking the guards.
I had to run away for fear (that) he might one day kill me.

senses.definition_vi: tránh nguy cơ điều gì đó xảy ra.

senses.definition: feeling frightened that you might be killed
senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy sợ hãi rằng bạn có thể bị giết.

senses.definition: used to say that you definitely do not want to do something

examples.x: ‘Are you coming climbing?’ ‘No fear!’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn chắc chắn không muốn làm điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to make somebody very frightened, especially in order to make them do something
senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó rất sợ hãi, đặc biệt là để buộc họ làm điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to make somebody be afraid, etc.

examples.x: The sound of gunfire struck fear into the hearts of the villagers.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó sợ hãi, v.v.

senses.definition: in a fair way

examples.x: They undertook to make their judgement without fear or favour.

senses.definition_vi: một cách công bằng.

senses.definition: to be frightened of somebody/something or frightened of doing something

examples.x: All his employees fear him.
They have reason to fear the police.
to fear death/persecution/the unknown
Everyone feared the coming war.
propaganda designed to make us hate and fear the enemy
Don't worry, you have nothing to fear from us.
She feared to tell him the truth.
She feared going out at night.

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy sợ ai đó/điều gì đó hoặc sợ làm điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to feel that something bad might have happened or might happen in the future

examples.x: She has been missing for three days now and police are beginning to fear the worst (= think that she is dead).
The government feared a backlash from farmers.
Experts fear that terrorists could use the internet to launch attacks.
They rightly feared that presidents, like kings, might abuse their power.
He genuinely feared his life was at risk.
The company feared losing its tax breaks.
Women and children are feared to be among the victims.
The death toll is not as bad as initially feared.
It is feared (that) he may have been kidnapped.
It was feared that unemployment could rise.
Hundreds of people are feared dead.
Never fear/Fear not (= Don’t worry), I shall return.

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy rằng điều gì đó tồi tệ có thể đã xảy ra hoặc có thể xảy ra trong tương lai.

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that you think that something bad has happened or is true

examples.x: They are unlikely to get here on time, I fear.
‘He must be dead then?’ ‘I fear so.’
‘She's not coming back?’ ‘I fear not.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói với ai đó rằng bạn nghĩ rằng điều gì đó tồi tệ đã xảy ra hoặc là sự thật.

senses.definition: people with little experience try to do the difficult or dangerous things that more experienced people would not consider doing
senses.definition_vi: những người ít kinh nghiệm cố gắng làm những việc khó khăn hoặc nguy hiểm mà những người có kinh nghiệm hơn sẽ không xem xét làm.

senses.definition: an action or a piece of work that needs skill, strength or courage

examples.x: The tunnel is a remarkable feat of engineering.
to accomplish/achieve/perform astonishing feats
That was no mean feat (= it was difficult to do).

senses.definition_vi: một hành động hoặc một công việc đòi hỏi kỹ năng, sức mạnh hoặc lòng dũng cảm.

senses.definition: one of the many soft light parts covering a bird’s body

examples.x: a peacock feather
tail/flight/wing feathers
a feather pillow (= one containing feathers)

senses.definition_vi: một trong nhiều bộ phận mềm, nhẹ bao phủ cơ thể chim.

senses.definition: people of the same sort (are found together)
senses.definition_vi: những người cùng loại (được tìm thấy cùng nhau).

senses.definition: an action that you can be proud of
senses.definition_vi: một hành động mà bạn có thể tự hào.

senses.definition: to annoy or upset somebody or a group of people

examples.x: The senator's speech ruffled a few feathers in the business world.

senses.definition_vi: làm phiền hoặc khó chịu ai đó hoặc một nhóm người.

senses.definition: to make somebody feel less angry or offended
senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy bớt tức giận hoặc khó chịu.

senses.definition: used to express surprise
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để bày tỏ sự ngạc nhiên.

senses.definition: something important, interesting or typical of a place or thing

examples.x: An interesting feature of the city is the old market.
geographical features
Teamwork is a key feature of the training programme.
I've added some new features to my website.
new safety/security features
There are a number of special features included on the disc.
The main bonus feature is a lengthy interview with the director.
The most distinctive feature of this track is the trumpet sound.
The one redeeming feature (= good thing about it) of the plan was its low cost.

senses.definition_vi: một cái gì đó quan trọng, thú vị hoặc điển hình của một địa điểm hoặc sự vật.

senses.definition: a part of somebody’s face such as their nose, mouth and eyes

examples.x: facial features
his strong handsome features
Her eyes are her most striking feature.

senses.definition_vi: một bộ phận trên khuôn mặt của ai đó như mũi, miệng và mắt.

senses.definition: a special article or programme about somebody/something

examples.x: In today's programme we have a special feature on education.
There are in-depth feature articles in every issue.
She is a feature writer for the ‘Evening Standard’.

senses.definition_vi: một bài viết hoặc chương trình đặc biệt về ai đó/điều gì đó.

senses.definition: the main film in a cinema programme
senses.definition_vi: bộ phim chính trong chương trình của rạp chiếu phim.

senses.definition: to include a particular person or thing as a special feature

examples.x: The film features Cary Grant as a professor.
The latest model features alloy wheels and an electronic alarm.
a new Star Wars movie featuring the original actors
The actress was featured on the cover of Time magazine last month.
Many of the hotels featured in the brochure offer special deals for weekend breaks.

senses.definition_vi: bao gồm một người hoặc vật cụ thể như một đặc điểm nổi bật.

senses.definition: to have an important part in something

examples.x: Olive oil and garlic feature prominently in his recipes.
Several local musicians featured on the album.
Reading over his past speeches, you'll see that housing, public health and education feature strongly.

senses.definition_vi: có một phần quan trọng trong một cái gì đó.

senses.definition: the 2nd month of the year, between January and March

examples.x: She was born in February.
The meeting is on the fifth of February/February the fifth.
The meeting is on February fifth.
We went to Japan last February.
I arrived at the end of February.
last February's election
It was a cold February morning.

senses.definition_vi: tháng thứ 2 trong năm, giữa tháng Giêng và tháng Ba.

senses.definition: having a system of government in which the individual states of a country have control over their own affairs, but are controlled by a central government for national decisions, etc.

examples.x: a federal republic

senses.definition_vi: có một hệ thống chính phủ trong đó các tiểu bang riêng lẻ có quyền kiểm soát các công việc của riêng họ, nhưng bị kiểm soát bởi chính phủ trung ương cho các quyết định quốc gia, v.v.

senses.definition: (within a federal system, for example the US and Canada) connected with national government rather than the local government of an individual state

examples.x: a federal law
state and federal income taxes

senses.definition_vi: (trong một hệ thống liên bang, ví dụ như Hoa Kỳ và Canada) liên quan đến chính phủ quốc gia chứ không phải chính quyền địa phương của một tiểu bang riêng lẻ.

senses.definition: an amount of money that you pay for professional advice or services

examples.x: Employees are reimbursed for any legal fees incurred when they relocate.
fee-paying schools (= that you have to pay to go to)
The school fees are expected to rise again next year.
Students take out loans to cover tuition fees.
Customers pay an annual fee for the service.
Does the bank charge a fee for setting up the account?
Users can block ads for a small monthly fee.

senses.definition_vi: một khoản tiền bạn trả cho lời khuyên hoặc dịch vụ chuyên nghiệp.

senses.definition: an amount of money that you pay to join an organization, or to do something

examples.x: a membership/subscription fee
There is no entrance fee to the gallery.
the TV licence fee
You have to pay a fee to enter the race.
The registration fee for the event is £35.

senses.definition_vi: một khoản tiền bạn trả để tham gia một tổ chức, hoặc để làm một việc gì đó.

senses.definition: a meal of milk for a young baby; a meal for an animal

examples.x: her morning feed

senses.definition_vi: bữa ăn bằng sữa cho trẻ sơ sinh; bữa ăn cho động vật.

senses.definition: food for animals or plants

examples.x: a sack of animal feed
winter feed for the horses
liquid tomato feed

senses.definition_vi: thức ăn cho động vật hoặc thực vật.

senses.definition: material supplied to a machine
senses.definition_vi: vật liệu được cung cấp cho máy móc.

senses.definition: a pipe, device, etc. that supplies a machine with something

examples.x: The printer has an automatic paper feed.
the cold feed to the water cylinder

senses.definition_vi: một ống, thiết bị, v.v. cung cấp cho máy móc một cái gì đó.

senses.definition: a large meal

examples.x: They needed a bath and a good feed.

senses.definition_vi: một bữa ăn lớn.

senses.definition: television programmes that are sent from a central station to other stations in a network; the system of sending out these programmes

examples.x: network feed

senses.definition_vi: các chương trình truyền hình được gửi từ một trạm trung tâm đến các trạm khác trong một mạng lưới; hệ thống phát sóng các chương trình này

senses.definition: a special feature on a blog, news website, social media site, etc. that allows you to see new information that has been added without having to visit the website, usually using a feed reader (= a piece of software that displays this information)

examples.x: an RSS feed
the film's official X feed

senses.definition_vi: một tính năng đặc biệt trên blog, trang web tin tức, trang mạng xã hội, v.v. cho phép bạn xem thông tin mới đã được thêm vào mà không cần truy cập trang web, thường sử dụng trình đọc feed (= một phần mềm hiển thị thông tin này)

senses.definition: to give food to a person or an animal

examples.x: Have you fed the cat yet?
The baby can't feed itself yet (= can't put food into its own mouth).
It's important to feed children a well-balanced diet.
He has to be fed liquids through a tube in his stomach.
The cattle are fed (on) barley.
The barley is fed to the cattle.
The animals are fed with hay and grass.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp thức ăn cho một người hoặc một con vật

senses.definition: to eat food

examples.x: Slugs and snails feed at night.

senses.definition_vi: ăn thức ăn

senses.definition: to provide food for a person or group of people

examples.x: They have a large family to feed.
There's enough here to feed an army.
Have they been feeding you well?
They struggled to feed and clothe the children.
Having another mouth (= person) to feed can be a strain.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp thức ăn cho một người hoặc một nhóm người

senses.definition: to give a plant a special substance to make it grow

examples.x: Feed the plants once a week.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp một chất đặc biệt cho cây để giúp cây phát triển

senses.definition: to give advice, information, etc. to somebody/something

examples.x: We are constantly fed gossip and speculation by the media.
The media were being fed with accusations and lies.
Gossip and speculation are constantly fed to us by the media.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp lời khuyên, thông tin, v.v. cho ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to supply something to somebody/something

examples.x: The lake is fed by a river.
The electricity line is fed with power through an underground cable.
Power is fed into the electricity line through an underground cable.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp một cái gì đó cho ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to put or push something into or through a machine

examples.x: He fed the meter with coins.
He fed coins into the meter.
The information was fed into the data store.
The fabric is fed through the machine.

senses.definition_vi: đưa hoặc đẩy một cái gì đó vào hoặc qua một máy móc

senses.definition: to satisfy a need, desire, etc. and keep it strong

examples.x: For drug addicts, the need to feed the addiction takes priority over everything else.

senses.definition_vi: thỏa mãn một nhu cầu, mong muốn, v.v. và giữ cho nó mạnh mẽ

senses.definition: to harm somebody who has helped you or supported you
senses.definition_vi: làm hại ai đó đã giúp đỡ hoặc ủng hộ bạn

senses.definition: to eat a lot of food or too much food
senses.definition_vi: ăn nhiều thức ăn hoặc quá nhiều thức ăn

senses.definition: advice, criticism or information about how good or useful something or somebody’s work is

examples.x: customer/user feedback
to provide/give feedback
to receive/get feedback
I'd appreciate some feedback on my work.
The teacher will give you feedback on the test.
I've heard loads of good feedback about this site.
We need both positive and negative feedback from our customers.

senses.definition_vi: lời khuyên, phê bình hoặc thông tin về mức độ tốt hoặc hữu ích của một cái gì đó hoặc công việc của ai đó

senses.definition: the unpleasant noise produced by electrical equipment such as an amplifier when some of the power returns to the system
senses.definition_vi: tiếng ồn khó chịu do thiết bị điện tử như bộ khuếch đại tạo ra khi một phần năng lượng quay trở lại hệ thống

senses.definition: the act of giving food to a person, an animal or a plant

examples.x: breast/bottle feeding
The cubs' feeding time at the zoo is 2 p.m.

senses.definition_vi: hành động cho một người, một con vật hoặc một cây trồng ăn

senses.definition: the feeling you get when you touch something or are touched

examples.x: You can tell it's silk by the feel.
The model has the look and feel of wood.
She loved the feel of the sun on her skin.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác bạn nhận được khi chạm vào thứ gì đó hoặc bị thứ gì đó chạm vào

senses.definition: an act of feeling or touching

examples.x: I had a feel of the material.

senses.definition_vi: hành động cảm nhận hoặc chạm

senses.definition: the impression that is created by a place, situation, etc.; atmosphere

examples.x: It's a big city but it has the feel of a small town.
The overall feel of the album is slow and dreamlike.
The film has a documentary feel to it.

senses.definition_vi: ấn tượng được tạo ra bởi một địa điểm, tình huống, v.v.; bầu không khí

senses.definition: feelings of extreme emotion

examples.x: The anniversary concert is guaranteed to give fans all the feels.

senses.definition_vi: cảm xúc cực đoan

senses.definition: to get/have an understanding of something or be naturally good at doing it

examples.x: She has a real feel for languages.

senses.definition_vi: nhận được/có được sự hiểu biết về một cái gì đó hoặc giỏi làm điều đó một cách tự nhiên

senses.definition: to become familiar with something or with doing something

examples.x: I haven't got the feel of the brakes in this car yet.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên quen thuộc với một cái gì đó hoặc với việc làm một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to experience a particular feeling or emotion

examples.x: The bus ride made me feel sick.
Are you feeling comfortable?
She sounded more confident than she felt.
I was feeling guilty.
You'll feel better after a good night's sleep.
I feel sorry for him.
I feel bad about leaving you like this.
She felt betrayed.
How are you feeling today?
I know exactly how you feel (= I feel sympathy for you).
We all felt the same way.
Luckily I was feeling in a good mood.
I felt the need to explain.
I felt a sense of relief.
I felt like a complete idiot.
She made me feel like a child by doing everything for me.
I feel as if nobody cares.
She felt as though she was going to cry.
to feel an idiot/a fool

senses.definition_vi: trải nghiệm một cảm giác hoặc cảm xúc cụ thể

senses.definition: to notice or be aware of something because it is touching you or having a physical effect on you

examples.x: I could feel the warm sun on my back.
She felt a sharp pain in her hand.
She could not feel her legs.
I can’t feel his pulse.
He felt a hand on his shoulder.
You may feel a slight pressure in your chest.
He felt a hand touching his shoulder.
She could feel herself blushing.
He felt the sweat running down his face.
I felt something crawl up my arm.
We felt the ground give way under our feet.

senses.definition_vi: nhận thấy hoặc nhận thức được một cái gì đó vì nó đang chạm vào bạn hoặc có tác động vật lý lên bạn

senses.definition: to become aware of something even though you cannot see it, hear it, etc.

examples.x: Can you feel the tension in this room?
They all feel pressure from managers to make a sale.
I definitely felt the importance of the occasion.

senses.definition_vi: nhận thức được một cái gì đó ngay cả khi bạn không thể nhìn thấy, nghe thấy nó, v.v.

senses.definition: to give you a particular feeling or impression

examples.x: This situation doesn't feel right.
You need to go somewhere that feels safe.
My mouth felt completely dry.

examples.cf: it feels + adj. to do something
examples.x: It felt strange to be back in my old school.
The place still feels like a small fishing village.
The interview only took ten minutes, but it felt like hours.
I've lived here for years, but it still doesn't feel like home.
It feels like rain (= seems likely to rain).
It's three degrees right now, but with the wind chill factor it feels like minus 12.
How does it feel to be alone all day?
Her head felt as if it would burst.
It felt as though he had run a marathon.

senses.definition_vi: mang lại cho bạn một cảm giác hoặc ấn tượng cụ thể

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả ai đó giống bạn theo một cách nào đó, hoặc ở cùng một tình huống

senses.definition_vi: tiền được sử dụng để điều hành một doanh nghiệp, một hoạt động hoặc một dự án

senses.definition: the activity of managing money, especially by a government or commercial organization

examples.x: the Minister of Finance
the finance director/department/committee
She's got a diploma in banking and finance.
the world of high finance (= finance involving large companies or countries)
an expert in public/personal/corporate finance
a finance company

senses.definition_vi: hoạt động quản lý tiền, đặc biệt là của chính phủ hoặc tổ chức thương mại

senses.definition: the money available to a person, an organization or a country; the way this money is managed

examples.x: government/public/personal finances
They were unable to manage their finances.
It's about time you sorted out your finances.
Moving house put a severe strain on our finances.
The firm’s finances are basically sound.

senses.definition_vi: số tiền có sẵn cho một người, một tổ chức hoặc một quốc gia; cách thức quản lý số tiền này

senses.definition: to provide money for a project

examples.x: He took a job to finance his stay in Germany.
The building project will be financed by the government.
The research is financed through government grants.
Today just 10% of car purchases are financed with loans.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp tiền cho một dự án

senses.definition: connected with money and finance

examples.x: the world's major financial markets/institutions
businesses in the financial sector
Tokyo and New York are major financial centres.
The company offers sophisticated financial services.
financial support/aid/assistance
an independent financial adviser
The current financial crisis is global.
His motives were purely financial.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến tiền và tài chính

senses.definition: having money
senses.definition_vi: có tiền

senses.definition: to discover somebody/something unexpectedly or by chance

examples.x: Look what I've found!
We've found a great new restaurant near the office.
A whale was found washed up on the shore.
They found a car abandoned on top of the cliff.

senses.definition_vi: khám phá ai đó/điều gì đó một cách bất ngờ hoặc tình cờ

senses.definition: to get back something/somebody that was lost after searching for it/them

examples.x: I can't find my keys.
I thought I'd lost my wallet but I found it under my desk.
I wanted to talk to him but he was nowhere to be found.
Can you find my bag for me?
Can you find me my bag?
The child was eventually found safe and well.

senses.definition_vi: tìm lại được ai đó/điều gì đó bị mất sau khi tìm kiếm nó/họ

senses.definition: to discover something/somebody by searching, studying or thinking carefully

examples.x: They found no evidence to support this claim.
We found a way out.
I managed to find a solution to the problem.
Our website is the place to find answers to all your questions.
He's struggling to find work.
Scientists are still trying to find a cure for cancer.
I'm having trouble finding anything new to say on this subject.
Have they found anyone to replace her yet?
It's hard to find a babysitter.
I'll find that information for you.
I'll find you that information.
His father found him a job.

senses.definition_vi: khám phá điều gì đó/ai đó bằng cách tìm kiếm, nghiên cứu hoặc suy nghĩ cẩn thận

senses.definition: to discover that something is true after you have tried it, tested it or experienced it

examples.x: I find (that) it pays to be honest.
A study found that green tea could be beneficial.
You'll find your opinions change as you get older.
We found the beds very comfortable.
They found him a plausible witness.
They found him to be charming.
Researchers found this to be the most effective method.
Her blood was found to contain poison.
If you are found to have lied, you can be charged.
It was found that her blood contained poison.

senses.definition_vi: khám phá ra điều gì đó là đúng sau khi bạn đã thử, kiểm tra hoặc trải nghiệm nó

senses.definition: to have a particular feeling or opinion about something

examples.x: You may find it hard to accept your illness.
You may find your illness hard to accept.
Do women find it more difficult to ask for a rise?
I found the book very interesting.
She finds it a strain to meet new people.
She finds meeting new people a strain.

senses.definition_vi: có một cảm giác hoặc ý kiến cụ thể về điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that something exists, grows, etc. somewhere

examples.x: These flowers are found only in Africa.
Further details can be found on our website.
You'll find this style of architecture all over the town.
Find us at www.oup.com.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó tồn tại, phát triển, v.v. ở một nơi nào đó

senses.definition: to discover somebody/something/yourself doing something or in a particular situation, especially when this is unexpected

examples.x: She woke up and found herself in a hospital bed.
I found the house in a mess.
We came home and found him asleep on the sofa.
I found myself forced to act.
He looked up to find her watching him.
I suddenly found myself running down the street.
She was surprised to find that everyone had left.

senses.definition_vi: khám phá ai đó/điều gì đó hoặc chính mình đang làm điều gì đó hoặc ở trong một tình huống cụ thể, đặc biệt là khi điều này là bất ngờ

senses.definition: to have something available so that you can use it

examples.x: I keep meaning to write, but never seem to find (the) time.
How are we going to find £10  000 for a car?

senses.definition_vi: có sẵn điều gì đó để bạn có thể sử dụng nó

senses.definition: to show a quality in yourself, usually with an effort

examples.x: I found the courage to speak.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện một phẩm chất ở bản thân, thường là bằng nỗ lực

senses.definition: to arrive at something naturally; to reach something/somebody

examples.x: Water will always find its own level.
Most of the money finds its way to the people who need it.
The criticism found its mark (= had the effect intended).
I hope this letter finds you in good health.

senses.definition_vi: tự nhiên đạt đến điều gì đó; đến được điều gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: to make a particular decision in a court case

examples.x: The jury found him guilty.
How do you find the accused?
The court found in her favour.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra một quyết định cụ thể trong một vụ án

senses.definition: with free food and accommodation in addition to your wages
senses.definition_vi: có thức ăn và chỗ ở miễn phí ngoài tiền lương của bạn

senses.definition: to look for and discover mistakes in somebody/something; to complain about somebody/something

examples.x: My mother did nothing but find fault with my manners.
My boss finds fault with everything I do.

senses.definition_vi: tìm và khám phá lỗi sai ở ai đó/điều gì đó; phàn nàn về ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to become able to act independently and with confidence

examples.x: I only recently joined the firm so I'm still finding my feet.

senses.definition_vi: có khả năng hành động độc lập và tự tin

senses.definition: to be able or willing to do something

examples.x: Can you find it in your heart to forgive her?
He couldn't find it in himself to trust anyone again.

senses.definition_vi: có khả năng hoặc sẵn lòng làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to meet somebody who is equal to or even better than you in strength, skill or intelligence

examples.x: He thought he could beat anyone at chess but he’s met his match in Peter.

senses.definition_vi: gặp ai đó ngang bằng hoặc thậm chí tốt hơn bạn về sức mạnh, kỹ năng hoặc trí thông minh

senses.definition: to be able to speak or express your opinion
senses.definition_vi: có thể nói hoặc bày tỏ ý kiến của mình

senses.definition: to discover the right route (to a place)

examples.x: I hope you can find your way home.

senses.definition_vi: khám phá đúng đường (đến một địa điểm)

senses.definition: to come to a place or a situation by chance or without intending to

examples.x: He eventually found his way into acting.

senses.definition_vi: đến một địa điểm hoặc một tình huống một cách tình cờ hoặc không có ý định

senses.definition: impossible for anyone to find or see

examples.x: I wanted to talk to him but he was nowhere to be found.
The children were nowhere to be seen.
A peace settlement is nowhere in sight (= is not likely in the near future).

senses.definition_vi: không thể ai đó tìm thấy hoặc nhìn thấy

senses.definition: to accept somebody as they are without expecting them to behave in a special way or have special qualities
senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận ai đó như họ vốn có mà không mong đợi họ cư xử đặc biệt hoặc có những phẩm chất đặc biệt

senses.definition: information that is discovered as the result of research into something

examples.x: Our research findings indicate that pregnant women benefit from this treatment.
These findings suggest that there is no direct link between unemployment and crime.
This result confirms the findings of many previous studies.
to report/present/publish your findings
I'll now summarize the key findings from these studies.
An interesting finding of the survey was that older people were happier than younger people.

senses.definition_vi: thông tin được khám phá như là kết quả của nghiên cứu về một điều gì đó

senses.definition: a decision made by the judge or jury in a court case

examples.x: The appeal court upheld a finding that the agreement was unlawful.
The court made a finding in favour of the defendant.

senses.definition_vi: một quyết định được đưa ra bởi thẩm phán hoặc bồi thẩm đoàn trong một vụ án

senses.definition: in good health

examples.x: ‘How are you?’ ‘Fine, thanks.’
I was feeling fine when I got up this morning.
‘How’s your throat?’ ‘It’s fine as long as I don’t cough.’

senses.definition_vi: trong tình trạng sức khỏe tốt

senses.definition: of high quality; good

examples.x: a very fine performance
fine clothes/wines/workmanship
It's a particularly fine example of Saxon architecture.
the finest collection of paintings in Europe
She's a fine actor and an even finer dancer.
Jim has made a fine job of the garden.
people who enjoy the finer things in life (= for example art, good food, etc.)
It was his finest hour (= most successful period) as manager of the England team.
This movie features some of her finest work.
He tried to appeal to their finer feelings (= feelings of duty, love, etc.)

senses.definition_vi: chất lượng cao; tốt

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that an action, a suggestion or a decision is acceptable

examples.x: ‘I'll leave this here, OK?’ ‘Fine.’
‘Bob wants to know if he can come too.’ ‘That's fine by me.’
If you don't agree, that's fine with him.
She has been virtually ignoring me but I'm fine with that.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói với ai đó rằng một hành động, một đề xuất hoặc một quyết định là có thể chấp nhận được

senses.definition: used to say you are satisfied with something

examples.x: Don't worry. Your speech was fine.
Other than a few damp spots, the place looked fine.
to sound/seem fine
You go on without me. I'll be fine.
‘Can I get you another drink?’ ‘No, thanks. I'm fine.’
Never mind, Jake. Everything will be just fine.
Your hair is perfectly fine the way it is.
This paper's not very good quality, but it's fine for rough work.
You're a fine one to talk! (= you are not in a position to criticize, give advice, etc.)
This is a fine (= terrible) mess we're in!

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói bạn hài lòng với điều gì đó

senses.definition: bright and not raining

examples.x: a fine day/evening
I hope it stays fine for the picnic.
It was a fine sunny morning.
That summer saw weeks of fine dry weather.

senses.definition_vi: sáng và không mưa

senses.definition: pleasant to look at

examples.x: a fine view
a fine-looking woman
a fine figure of a man
The boy looks mighty fine in a uniform.

senses.definition_vi: dễ nhìn

senses.definition: made of very small grains

examples.x: fine sand
Use a finer piece of sandpaper to finish.
The top 8 inches of earth is very fine, made up of river sediment.
Dip in beaten egg then fine dry breadcrumbs before frying in olive oil.

senses.definition_vi: làm bằng hạt rất nhỏ

senses.definition: attractive and small or thin

examples.x: fine bone china
She has inherited her mother's fine features (= a small nose, mouth, etc.).

senses.definition_vi: xinh đẹp và nhỏ bé hoặc mỏng manh.

senses.definition: very thin or narrow; made of very thin or narrow wires or threads

examples.x: His fine blond hair came down almost to his shoulders.
a fine thread
I need a brush with a fine tip.
a fine sieve/mesh

senses.definition_vi: rất mỏng hoặc hẹp; làm bằng dây hoặc sợi rất mỏng hoặc hẹp.

senses.definition: difficult to see or describe

examples.x: You really need a magnifying glass to appreciate all the fine detail.
There's no need to make such fine distinctions.
There's a fine line between love and hate (= it is easy for one to become the other).
We still have to iron out the finer details.

senses.definition_vi: khó nhìn thấy hoặc mô tả.

senses.definition: that you have a lot of respect for

examples.x: He was a fine man.

senses.definition_vi: mà bạn rất tôn trọng.

senses.definition: sounding important and impressive but unlikely to have any effect

examples.x: His speech was full of fine words which meant nothing.

senses.definition_vi: nghe có vẻ quan trọng và ấn tượng nhưng khó có tác dụng.

senses.definition: containing only a particular metal and no other substances that reduce the quality

examples.x: fine gold

senses.definition_vi: chứa duy nhất một kim loại cụ thể và không có các chất khác làm giảm chất lượng.

senses.definition: people say chance would be a fine thing to show that they would like to do or have the thing that somebody has mentioned, but that they do not think that it is very likely
senses.definition_vi: người ta nói 'chance would be a fine thing' để thể hiện rằng họ muốn làm hoặc có thứ mà ai đó đã đề cập, nhưng họ không nghĩ điều đó có khả năng xảy ra.

senses.definition: the more complicated or detailed aspects of something

examples.x: She seems at ease discussing the finer points of foreign policy.
He learnt the finer points of cricket during a trip to London.

senses.definition_vi: các khía cạnh phức tạp hoặc chi tiết của một cái gì đó.

senses.definition: healthy; in good condition

examples.x: The team is in fine fettle.
Park Foods is in fine fettle after selling off all non-core businesses.

senses.definition_vi: khỏe mạnh; trong tình trạng tốt.

senses.definition: used to emphasize something that is expressed clearly and directly, especially a criticism

examples.x: Not to put too fine a point on it, I think you are lying.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh một điều gì đó được diễn đạt rõ ràng và trực tiếp, đặc biệt là một lời chỉ trích.

senses.definition: to be in a difficult or dangerous situation where you could easily make a mistake

examples.x: He was walking a fine line between being funny and being rude.
She often seems to tread a thin line between success and failure.

senses.definition_vi: ở trong một tình huống khó khăn hoặc nguy hiểm, nơi bạn có thể dễ dàng mắc sai lầm.

senses.definition: a sum of money that must be paid as punishment for breaking a law or rule

examples.x: I got a parking fine for parking on double yellow lines.
Offenders will be liable to a heavy fine (= one that costs a lot of money).
Under the new law, motorists face fines of up to £1 000.
She has already paid over $2 000 in fines.

senses.definition_vi: một khoản tiền phải trả như một sự trừng phạt vì vi phạm luật hoặc quy tắc.

senses.definition: to make somebody pay money as an official punishment

examples.x: The magistrate fined him $400.
Any company found to be breaking these rules will be heavily fined.
She was fined for speeding.
The company was fined £20 000 for breaching safety regulations.
He got fined £200 for parking illegally.

senses.definition_vi: buộc ai đó phải trả tiền như một hình phạt chính thức.

senses.definition: one of the four long thin parts that stick out from the hand (or five, if the thumb is included)

examples.x: She ran her fingers through her hair.
Hold the material between finger and thumb.
He was about to speak but she raised a finger to her lips.
The old man wagged his finger at the youths.
Tina curled her slender fingers into a fist.

senses.definition_vi: một trong bốn bộ phận dài, mảnh nhô ra từ bàn tay (hoặc năm, nếu bao gồm cả ngón cái).

senses.definition: having the type of fingers mentioned; having or using the number of fingers mentioned

examples.x: long-fingered
nimble-fingered
a four-fingered chord

senses.definition_vi: có loại ngón tay được đề cập; có hoặc sử dụng số lượng ngón tay được đề cập.

senses.definition: the part of a glove that covers the finger
senses.definition_vi: bộ phận của găng tay che ngón tay.

senses.definition: a long narrow piece of bread, cake, land, etc.

examples.x: chocolate fingers
a finger of toast
a narrow finger of land pointing out into the sea

senses.definition_vi: một miếng bánh mì, bánh ngọt, đất đai, v.v. dài và hẹp.

senses.definition: used to say that the total number of somebody/something is very small

examples.x: She could count on the fingers of one hand the people she actually enjoyed being with.
Although she knew lots of people, she could count her friends on the fingers of one hand.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng tổng số người/vật rất nhỏ.

senses.definition: to be awkward with your hands so that you drop things or are unable to do something
senses.definition_vi: vụng về tay đến mức làm rơi đồ hoặc không thể làm gì đó.

senses.definition: to suffer as a result of doing something without realizing the possible bad results, especially in business

examples.x: He got his fingers badly burnt dabbling in the stock market.

senses.definition_vi: chịu đựng hậu quả do làm điều gì đó mà không nhận ra kết quả xấu có thể xảy ra, đặc biệt là trong kinh doanh.

senses.definition: to hope that your plans will be successful (sometimes putting one finger across another as a sign of hoping for good luck)

examples.x: I'm crossing my fingers that my proposal will be accepted.
Keep your fingers crossed!

senses.definition_vi: hy vọng kế hoạch của bạn sẽ thành công (đôi khi bắt chéo ngón tay như một dấu hiệu hy vọng điều tốt lành).

senses.definition: used to refer to an estimate or method of doing something that is not very accurate or scientific and partly based on guessing

examples.x: It isn’t an exact science—it’s a kind of finger in the air thing.
‘It’s all a bit finger in the air,’ admitted a spokesman.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ một ước tính hoặc phương pháp làm việc không rất chính xác hoặc khoa học và một phần dựa trên sự đoán mò.

senses.definition: if the finger of blame/suspicion points or is pointed at somebody, they are suspected of having committed a crime, being responsible for something, etc.

examples.x: The inquiry pointed the finger of blame at the driver of the crashed coach.
The finger of suspicion was pointed at the chicken served for lunch.

senses.definition_vi: nếu ngón tay đổ lỗi/nghi ngờ chỉ vào ai đó, họ bị nghi ngờ đã phạm tội, chịu trách nhiệm về điều gì đó, v.v.

senses.definition: used to tell somebody to start doing some work or making an effort

examples.x: You're going to have to pull your finger out if you want to pass this exam.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để yêu cầu ai đó bắt đầu làm việc hoặc nỗ lực.

senses.definition: to raise your middle finger in the air with the back part of your hand facing somebody, done to be rude to somebody or to show them that you are angry
senses.definition_vi: giơ ngón giữa lên không trung với mặt sau bàn tay hướng về ai đó, làm điều này để tỏ thái độ thô lỗ hoặc tức giận với ai đó.

senses.definition: to be involved in a lot of different activities and have influence over them, especially when other people think that this is annoying
senses.definition_vi: tham gia vào nhiều hoạt động và có ảnh hưởng đến chúng, đặc biệt là khi người khác cho rằng điều đó gây khó chịu.

senses.definition: to always be aware of the most recent developments in a particular situation
senses.definition_vi: luôn nhận thức được những diễn biến mới nhất trong một tình huống cụ thể.

senses.definition: to be stealing money from the place where you work
senses.definition_vi: ăn cắp tiền từ nơi bạn làm việc.

senses.definition: to be likely to steal something
senses.definition_vi: có khả năng ăn cắp một cái gì đó.

senses.definition: to touch somebody with the intention of hurting them physically

examples.x: I never laid a finger on her.
If you lay a finger on me, I’ll call the police.

senses.definition_vi: chạm vào ai đó với ý định làm tổn thương họ về thể chất.

senses.definition: to miss or fail to use an opportunity

examples.x: Don't let the chance to work abroad slip through your fingers.

senses.definition_vi: bỏ lỡ hoặc không tận dụng một cơ hội.

senses.definition: to do nothing to help somebody

examples.x: The children never lift a finger to help around the house.

senses.definition_vi: không làm gì để giúp đỡ ai đó.

senses.definition: to accuse somebody of doing something

examples.x: The article points an accusing finger at the authorities.

senses.definition_vi: buộc tội ai đó đã làm điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to (not) be able to identify what is wrong or different about a particular situation

examples.x: There was something odd about him but I couldn't put my finger on it.
You've put your finger on something there—we'll need to investigate that.

senses.definition_vi: không thể xác định được điều gì sai hoặc khác biệt về một tình huống cụ thể.

senses.definition: to form the shape of a V with the two fingers nearest your thumb and raise your hand in the air with the back part of it facing somebody, done to be rude to them or to show them that you are angry

examples.x: She enjoys sticking two fingers up to convention.

senses.definition_vi: tạo hình chữ V bằng hai ngón tay gần ngón cái và giơ tay lên không trung với mặt sau bàn tay hướng về ai đó, làm điều này để tỏ thái độ thô lỗ hoặc tức giận với họ.

senses.definition: to make a sharp noise by moving your second or third finger quickly against your thumb, to attract somebody’s attention, or to mark the beat of music, for example

examples.x: He snapped his fingers for the waiter.
She only has to snap her fingers and her assistant comes running.

senses.definition_vi: tạo ra một tiếng động sắc nét bằng cách di chuyển ngón thứ hai hoặc thứ ba nhanh chóng với ngón cái, để thu hút sự chú ý của ai đó, hoặc để đánh dấu nhịp điệu của âm nhạc, chẳng hạn.

senses.definition: to work very hard
senses.definition_vi: làm việc rất chăm chỉ.

senses.definition: the last part or the end of something

examples.x: It was a close finish as they had predicted.
They won in the end but it was a tight finish.
a dramatic finish to the race
The story was a lie from start to finish.
I want to see the job through to the finish.
Several runners needed medical attention at the finish.

senses.definition_vi: phần cuối cùng hoặc điểm kết thúc của một cái gì đó.

senses.definition: the position in which a person or team finishes a competition

examples.x: a second-/third-/fourth-place finish
The team are aiming for a top-five finish.
