examples.x: They were attracted to each other from the first.

senses.definition_vi: từ lúc bắt đầu

senses.definition: from beginning to end; during the whole time

examples.x: It's a fine performance that commands attention from first to last.

senses.definition_vi: từ đầu đến cuối; trong suốt thời gian

senses.definition: happening or coming before all other similar things or people; 1st

examples.x: her first husband
the first turning on the right
I didn't take the first bus.
It was the first time they had ever met.
It's always exciting to visit a country for the first time.
students in their first year at college
First impressions can be misleading.
She resolved to do it at the first (= earliest) opportunity.
King Edward I (= pronounced ‘King Edward the First’)
the first of May/May 1st
His second book is better than his first.

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc đến trước tất cả những thứ hoặc người tương tự khác; thứ 1

senses.definition: the most important or best

examples.x: Your first duty is to your family.
She won first prize in the competition.
an issue of the first importance

senses.definition_vi: quan trọng nhất hoặc tốt nhất

senses.definition: used to introduce the first of a list of points you want to make in a speech or piece of writing

examples.x: There are two reasons for this decision: firstly…
Firstly let me introduce myself.
So where do we start? Well firstly, you need to assess your financial situation.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để giới thiệu điểm đầu tiên trong danh sách các điểm bạn muốn nêu ra trong một bài phát biểu hoặc bài viết

senses.definition: a creature that lives in water, breathes through gills, and uses fins and a tail for swimming

examples.x: They caught several fish.
In the pool she could see little silvery fish darting around.
tropical/marine/freshwater fish
Herring are relatively oily fish.
shoals (= groups) of fish
There are about 30 000 species of fish in the world.
The list of endangered species includes nearly 600 fishes.
a fish tank/pond
Fish stocks in the Baltic are in decline.
Fish farming has boomed in the past three decades.

senses.definition_vi: một sinh vật sống dưới nước, thở bằng mang, và sử dụng vây và đuôi để bơi

senses.definition: the soft part of fish that is eaten as food

examples.x: a regular diet of fresh fish
fried/grilled/smoked/dried fish
fish pie/soup
The chef's fish dishes are his speciality.
Fish forms the main part of their diet.

senses.definition_vi: phần thịt mềm của cá được ăn làm thức ăn

senses.definition: used to emphasize how easy it is to do something

examples.x: What do you mean you can't do it? It'll be like shooting fish in a barrel!

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nhấn mạnh mức độ dễ dàng của một việc gì đó

senses.definition: an important person (in a small community)
senses.definition_vi: một người quan trọng (trong một cộng đồng nhỏ)

senses.definition: a person who seems unfriendly and without strong emotions
senses.definition_vi: một người có vẻ không thân thiện và thiếu cảm xúc mạnh mẽ

senses.definition: a completely different situation or person from the one previously mentioned
senses.definition_vi: một tình huống hoặc người hoàn toàn khác với người hoặc tình huống được đề cập trước đó

senses.definition: to drink a lot of alcohol regularly

examples.x: Simon used to drink like a fish.

senses.definition_vi: uống nhiều rượu thường xuyên

senses.definition: a person who feels uncomfortable because they are in an environment that is not familiar
senses.definition_vi: một người cảm thấy không thoải mái vì họ ở trong một môi trường không quen thuộc

senses.definition: to have more important or more interesting things to do
senses.definition_vi: có những việc quan trọng hơn hoặc thú vị hơn để làm

senses.definition: neither one thing nor another

examples.x: The hovercraft has always suffered from the fact that it is neither fish nor fowl.

senses.definition_vi: không phải cái này cũng không phải cái kia

senses.definition: a person who is slightly strange or crazy
senses.definition_vi: một người hơi kỳ lạ hoặc điên rồ

senses.definition: used to comfort somebody whose romantic relationship has ended by saying that there are many other people they may have a successful relationship with in the future
senses.definition_vi: được dùng để an ủi ai đó có mối quan hệ lãng mạn đã kết thúc bằng cách nói rằng có rất nhiều người khác mà họ có thể có một mối quan hệ thành công trong tương lai

senses.definition: to try to catch fish with nets, a fishing line, etc.

examples.x: The trawler was fishing off the coast of Iceland.
Several people were fishing in the river.
You can fish for trout in this stream.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng bắt cá bằng lưới, dây câu, v.v.

senses.definition: to spend time fishing for pleasure

examples.x: Let's go fishing this weekend.
I used to go salmon fishing in the Waitaki River.

senses.definition_vi: dành thời gian câu cá để giải trí

senses.definition: to try to catch fish in the area of water mentioned

examples.x: They fished the loch for salmon.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng bắt cá trong khu vực nước được đề cập

senses.definition: to search for something, using your hands

examples.x: She fished around in her bag for her keys.

senses.definition_vi: tìm kiếm thứ gì đó bằng tay

senses.definition: the sport or business of catching fish

examples.x: They often go fishing.
We enjoyed a day's fishing by the river.
deep-sea fishing
trout/salmon/tuna fishing
a fishing boat/vessel
the fishing industry
Do you want to go on a fishing trip this summer?
the rich fishing grounds off the coast of Namibia
the picturesque fishing village of Polperro

senses.definition_vi: môn thể thao hoặc hoạt động kinh doanh bắt cá

senses.definition: healthy and strong, especially because you do regular physical exercise

examples.x: Top athletes have to be very fit.
She tries to keep fit by jogging every day.
Hiking helps keep him physically fit.
All the recruits seemed fit and healthy.
my new year's resolution to get fit
He is back in training after his back injury but is not yet considered match fit (= fit enough to play in a match).
He won't be fit to play in the match on Saturday.
The judge concluded that the applicant was fit to stand trial.
He's had a bad cold and isn't fit enough for work yet.
After two days, Douglas was declared fit for duty.
The government aims to make British industry leaner and fitter (= employing fewer people and with lower costs).

senses.definition_vi: khỏe mạnh và cường tráng, đặc biệt là vì bạn tập thể dục thường xuyên

senses.definition: suitable; of the right quality; with the right qualities or skills

examples.x: The food was not fit for human consumption.
It was a meal fit for a king (= of very good quality).
The children seem to think I'm only fit for cooking and washing!
Your car isn't fit to be on the road!
He's so angry he's in no fit state to see anyone.
This is not a fit place for you to live.
He was not considered a fit and proper person to run a bank.
Schools should be allowed to operate as they deem fit.

senses.definition_vi: thích hợp; có chất lượng phù hợp; có phẩm chất hoặc kỹ năng phù hợp

senses.definition: ready or likely to do something extreme

examples.x: They worked until they were fit to drop (= so tired that they were likely to fall down).
I've eaten so much I'm fit to burst.
She was laughing fit to burst (= very much).

senses.definition_vi: sẵn sàng hoặc có khả năng làm điều gì đó cực đoan

senses.definition: sexually attractive
senses.definition_vi: hấp dẫn về mặt tình dục

senses.definition: extremely fit or healthy
senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ khỏe mạnh hoặc có sức khỏe tốt

senses.definition: in very good physical condition
senses.definition_vi: có thể chất rất tốt

senses.definition: (of an institution, a system, a thing, etc.) suitable for the function or purpose that it was designed for

examples.x: The minister argued that the education system wasn’t fit for purpose.
The new executive flats are fully equipped and fit for purpose.
I returned the goods as they weren’t fit for purpose.

senses.definition_vi: (của một tổ chức, hệ thống, đồ vật, v.v.) phù hợp với chức năng hoặc mục đích mà nó được thiết kế

senses.definition: to consider it right or acceptable to do something; to decide or choose to do something

examples.x: You must do as you think fit (= but I don't agree with your decision).
The newspaper did not see fit to publish my letter (= and I criticize it for that).

senses.definition_vi: coi đó là đúng hoặc chấp nhận được để làm điều gì đó; quyết định hoặc chọn làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: the principle that only the people or things that are best adapted to their environment will continue to exist
senses.definition_vi: nguyên tắc rằng chỉ những người hoặc vật thích nghi tốt nhất với môi trường của họ mới tiếp tục tồn tại

senses.definition: a sudden attack of an illness, such as epilepsy, in which somebody becomes unconscious and their body may make violent movements

examples.x: to have an epileptic fit
He suffered from headaches and fainting fits.
Her fits are now controlled by drugs.

senses.definition_vi: một cơn tấn công đột ngột của bệnh, chẳng hạn như bệnh động kinh, trong đó ai đó bất tỉnh và cơ thể họ có thể có những cử động mạnh

senses.definition: a sudden short period of coughing (= forcing air through the throat noisily) or of laughing, that you cannot control

examples.x: a fit of coughing
He had us all in fits (of laughter) with his jokes.

senses.definition_vi: một cơn ho ngắn hoặc một cơn cười ngắn, không kiểm soát được

senses.definition: a short period of very strong feeling

examples.x: to act in a fit of anger/rage/temper/pique

senses.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian ngắn của cảm xúc rất mạnh

senses.definition: the way that something, especially a piece of clothing, fits; the way that somebody/something fits into something

examples.x: The shoe has a special strap to ensure a good fit.
It was a tight fit with six of us in the boat.

senses.definition_vi: cách một thứ gì đó, đặc biệt là một món quần áo, vừa vặn; cách ai đó/thứ gì đó vừa vặn vào thứ gì đó

senses.definition: the way that two things match each other or are suitable for each other

examples.x: a perfect fit between the recruit and the job

senses.definition_vi: cách hai thứ khớp với nhau hoặc phù hợp với nhau

senses.definition: frequently starting and stopping again; not continuously

examples.x: Because of other commitments I can only write my book in fits and starts.

senses.definition_vi: thường xuyên bắt đầu và dừng lại; không liên tục

senses.definition: to be very shocked, upset or angry

examples.x: Your mother would have a fit if she knew you'd been drinking!

senses.definition_vi: rất sốc, buồn hoặc tức giận

senses.definition: to be the right shape and size for somebody/something

examples.x: I tried the dress on but it didn't fit.
That jacket fits well.
My shoes fit perfectly.
a close-fitting dress
I can't find clothes to fit me.
The key doesn't fit the lock.

senses.definition_vi: có đúng hình dạng và kích thước cho ai đó/thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to be of the right size, type or number to go somewhere

examples.x: I'd like to have a desk in the room but it won't fit.
This device is small enough to fit in a pocket.
His arms fitted snugly around me.

senses.definition_vi: vừa vặn về kích thước, loại hoặc số lượng để đặt ở đâu đó

senses.definition: to put clothes on somebody and make them the right size and shape

examples.x: I'm going to be fitted for my wedding dress today.

senses.definition_vi: mặc quần áo cho ai đó và làm cho chúng có kích thước và hình dạng phù hợp

senses.definition: to put or fix something somewhere

examples.x: They fitted a smoke alarm to the ceiling.
uPVC windows have been fitted throughout the house.
The rooms were all fitted with smoke alarms.

senses.definition_vi: đặt hoặc gắn một thứ gì đó ở đâu đó

senses.definition: to put or join something in the right place

examples.x: The glass fits on top of the jug to form a lid.
How do these two parts fit together?
We fitted together the pieces of the puzzle.
If the top of the box fits badly, the contents will spill out.

senses.definition_vi: đặt hoặc ghép một thứ gì đó vào đúng vị trí

senses.definition: to agree with, match or be suitable for something; to make something do this

examples.x: Something doesn't quite fit here.
His pictures don't fit into any category.
The words fit perfectly with the music.
The facts certainly fit your theory.
to fit a description/profile
The punishment ought to fit the crime.
We tailor our programs to fit their needs.
Most organizations do not fit this model.
We should fit the punishment to the crime.

senses.definition_vi: hợp với, tương xứng hoặc phù hợp với một cái gì đó; làm cho một cái gì đó phù hợp

senses.definition: to make somebody/something suitable for a particular job or situation

examples.x: His experience fitted him perfectly for the job.
She was well fitted to the role of tragic heroine.
His experience fitted him to do the job.
Natural selection will see to it that animals are well fitted to survive in their environment.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó phù hợp với một công việc hoặc tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: to be like a particular person or thing

examples.x: A child answering the description of the missing boy was found safe and well in London yesterday.
We're all looking for quick, healthy meals, and pasta fits this description.

senses.definition_vi: giống một người hoặc một vật cụ thể

senses.definition: used to say that somebody will/will not get a particular job or position because they have/do not have the appearance, personality, etc. that the employer wants, even when this should not be important

examples.x: If your face fits, you'll get the job.
It doesn't matter how well qualified you are; if your face doesn't fit, you don't stand a chance.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng ai đó sẽ/sẽ không nhận được một công việc hoặc vị trí cụ thể vì họ có/không có ngoại hình, tính cách, v.v. mà nhà tuyển dụng mong muốn, ngay cả khi điều này không nên quan trọng

senses.definition: to be what is needed in a particular situation or for a particular purpose

examples.x: On paper, several of the applicants fit the bill.

senses.definition_vi: là những gì cần thiết trong một tình huống hoặc cho một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: to be the perfect size or shape for somebody

examples.x: The dress fits me like a glove.

senses.definition_vi: có kích thước hoặc hình dạng hoàn hảo cho ai đó

senses.definition: if you feel that a remark applies to you, you should accept it and take it as a warning or criticism
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn cảm thấy một nhận xét áp dụng cho bạn, bạn nên chấp nhận nó và coi đó là một lời cảnh báo hoặc lời chỉ trích

senses.definition: the state of being physically healthy and strong

examples.x: a magazine on health and fitness
He is a qualified fitness instructor.
She works as a personal fitness trainer.
The player failed a fitness test this week.
The club runs several fitness classes.
My brother has always been a fitness fanatic.
I follow a daily fitness routine.
a high level of physical fitness

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng sức khỏe thể chất và sự cường tráng

senses.definition: the state of being suitable or good enough for something

examples.x: He convinced us of his fitness for the task.
There were doubts about her fitness to hold office.

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng phù hợp hoặc đủ tốt cho một cái gì đó

examples.x: There are only five cookies left.
five of Sweden’s top financial experts
Ten people were invited but only five turned up.
Do you have change for five dollars?
a five-month contract
Look at page five.
Five and four is nine.
Three fives are fifteen.
I can't read your writing—is this meant to be a five?
The bulbs are planted in threes or fives (= groups of three or five).
We moved to America when I was five (= five years old).
Shall we meet at five (= at five o'clock), then?

senses.definition: the amount of fruit or vegetables that some organizations say you should eat in order to be healthy

examples.x: Start your five a day with a banana for breakfast.

senses.definition_vi: lượng trái cây hoặc rau quả mà một số tổ chức nói rằng bạn nên ăn để có sức khỏe

senses.definition: to hit the inside of somebody’s hand with your hand as a way of saying hello or to celebrate a victory

examples.x: Give me five!

senses.definition_vi: đập vào lòng bàn tay của ai đó bằng tay của bạn như một cách để chào hỏi hoặc để ăn mừng chiến thắng

senses.definition: the normal working hours in an office

examples.x: I work nine to five.
a nine-to-five job

senses.definition_vi: giờ làm việc bình thường trong văn phòng

senses.definition: a solution to a problem, especially an easy or temporary one

examples.x: Luckily there is an easy fix.
a short-term/temporary/permanent fix
There is no quick fix for the steel industry.
There had to be a technological fix for the problem.

senses.definition_vi: một giải pháp cho một vấn đề, đặc biệt là một giải pháp dễ dàng hoặc tạm thời

senses.definition: an amount of something that you need and want frequently, especially an illegal drug such as heroin

examples.x: to get yourself a fix
I need a fix of coffee before I can face the day.

senses.definition_vi: một lượng của một thứ gì đó mà bạn cần và muốn thường xuyên, đặc biệt là một loại thuốc bất hợp pháp như heroin

senses.definition: a difficult situation

examples.x: We've got ourselves in a fix about this.

senses.definition_vi: một tình huống khó khăn

senses.definition: the act of finding the position of a ship or an aircraft

examples.x: They managed to get a fix on the yacht's position.

senses.definition_vi: hành động tìm vị trí của một con tàu hoặc máy bay

senses.definition: an act of understanding something

examples.x: He tried to get a fix on the young man's motives, but he just couldn't understand him.

senses.definition_vi: hành động hiểu một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a thing that is dishonestly arranged; a trick

examples.x: Her promotion was a fix, I'm sure!

senses.definition_vi: một thứ gì đó được sắp xếp một cách không trung thực; một trò lừa bịp

senses.definition: to repair or correct something

examples.x: The car won't start—can you fix it?
I've fixed the problem.
Businesses and government have spent billions of dollars to find and fix the bug.
We need to get the TV fixed.
If you suspect that you have a fuel leak have it fixed as soon as possible.

senses.definition_vi: sửa chữa hoặc khắc phục một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to decide on a date, a time, an amount, etc. for something

examples.x: Has the date of the next meeting been fixed?
Their prices are fixed until the end of the year (= will not change before then).
A second trial date was fixed for 7th December.
They fixed the rent at £200 a week.
Crop prices were fixed at $ 1.98 per bushel for corn.

senses.definition_vi: quyết định một ngày, một thời gian, một số lượng, v.v. cho một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to arrange or organize something

examples.x: I'll fix a meeting.
You have to fix visits up in advance with the museum.
Just give me a list of your friends, and I'll fix things up for them.
Don't worry, I'll fix it with Sarah.

examples.cf: fix up (for somebody) to do something
examples.x: I’ve fixed up (for us) to go to the theatre next week.

senses.definition_vi: sắp xếp hoặc tổ chức một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to put something in a place so that it will not move

examples.x: to fix a shelf to the wall
to fix a post in the ground
Play equipment such as swings and climbing frames should be securely fixed and well maintained.
He noted every detail so as to fix the scene in his mind.

senses.definition_vi: đặt một thứ gì đó ở một nơi để nó không di chuyển

senses.definition: to discover or say the exact position, time, etc. of something

examples.x: We can fix the ship's exact position at the time the fire broke out.

senses.definition_vi: xác định hoặc nói vị trí, thời gian, v.v. chính xác của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to provide or prepare something, especially food

examples.x: Can I fix you a drink?
I'm just going to fix myself some breakfast.
Can I fix a drink for you?
I'll fix supper.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp hoặc chuẩn bị một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là thức ăn

senses.definition: to make something such as your hair or face neat and attractive

examples.x: I'll fix my hair and then I'll be ready.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho tóc hoặc mặt của bạn gọn gàng và hấp dẫn

senses.definition: to arrange the result of something in a way that is not honest or fair

examples.x: I'm sure the race was fixed.

senses.definition_vi: sắp xếp kết quả của một cái gì đó theo cách không trung thực hoặc không công bằng

senses.definition: to punish somebody who has harmed you and stop them doing you any more harm

examples.x: Don't worry—I'll fix him.

senses.definition_vi: trừng phạt ai đó đã làm hại bạn và ngăn họ làm hại bạn thêm nữa

senses.definition: to treat film for cameras, etc. with a chemical so that the colours do not change or become less bright
senses.definition_vi: xử lý phim cho máy ảnh, v.v. bằng hóa chất để màu sắc không thay đổi hoặc bớt rực rỡ

senses.definition: to make an animal unable to have young by means of an operation
senses.definition_vi: làm cho động vật không thể sinh sản bằng phẫu thuật

senses.definition: to intend to do something

examples.x: We're not fixing to go there anytime soon.

senses.definition_vi: có ý định làm một việc gì đó

senses.definition: to look directly at somebody for a long time

examples.x: He fixed her with an angry stare.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn thẳng vào ai đó trong một thời gian dài

senses.definition: used to say that if something works well enough, it should not be changed
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng nếu một cái gì đó hoạt động đủ tốt, nó không nên được thay đổi

senses.definition: staying the same; not changing or able to be changed

examples.x: These fixed prices give farmers a degree of financial security.
These accounts offer a fixed rate of interest over a defined period.
Older people living on fixed incomes are especially vulnerable to energy cost increases.
Speeders risk a fixed penalty of £95.
The money has been invested for a fixed period.

senses.definition_vi: không thay đổi hoặc không thể thay đổi

senses.definition: held very strongly; not easily changed

examples.x: My parents had fixed ideas about what I should become.
Many parents have quite fixed views as to what schools they want their children to attend.

senses.definition: to come or go after or behind somebody in order to watch where they go and what they do

examples.x: I think we're being followed.
Police followed the car along Station Road where it mounted the kerb again.
As she walked home, she had the feeling she was being followed.

senses.definition_vi: đi đến hoặc đi sau ai đó để xem họ đi đâu và làm gì.

senses.definition: to come after something/somebody else in time or order; to happen as a result of something else

examples.x: I remember little of the days that followed the accident.
A period of unrest followed the president's resignation.
The first two classes are followed by a break of ten minutes.
The main course was followed by fresh fruit.
I'll have soup and fish to follow.
A detailed news report will follow shortly.
There followed a short silence.
The opening hours are as follows…
A new proposal followed on from the discussions.
the workers' revolts that followed in the wake of the student uprising

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra sau thứ gì đó/ai đó khác về thời gian hoặc thứ tự; xảy ra như một kết quả của thứ gì đó khác.

senses.definition: to do something after something else

examples.x: Give your contact details and follow this with a brief profile of yourself.
They follow up their March show with four UK dates next month.

senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó sau điều khác.

senses.definition: to accept advice, instructions, etc. and do what you have been told or shown to do

examples.x: to follow rules/procedures/guidelines
They said they were just following orders.
Follow the instructions very carefully.
Why didn't you follow my advice?
Turn right and follow signs to Dundee.
I never follow a recipe completely.
He followed a strict diet.

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận lời khuyên, hướng dẫn, v.v. và làm những gì bạn đã được bảo hoặc chỉ cho làm.

senses.definition: to accept somebody/something as a guide, a leader or an example; to copy somebody/something

examples.x: I encourage others to follow our example.
The Senate is expected to follow the lead of the House.
We believe it is in our best interests to follow the path of economic openness and growth.
The movie follows the book faithfully.
They followed the teachings of Buddha.
He always followed the latest fashions (= dressed in fashionable clothes).
Where one airline leads, others follow.
Laura followed her mother into the medical profession (= became a doctor like her mother).

senses.definition_vi: chấp nhận ai đó/thứ gì đó làm người hướng dẫn, người lãnh đạo hoặc tấm gương; sao chép ai đó/thứ gì đó.

senses.definition: to click on a link in a website

examples.x: Follow the links to sign up for the webinar.

senses.definition_vi: nhấp vào một liên kết trên trang web.

senses.definition: to go along a road, path, etc.

examples.x: Follow this road until you get to the school, then turn left.

senses.definition_vi: đi dọc theo một con đường, lối đi, v.v.

senses.definition: to go in the same direction as something or parallel to something

examples.x: The lane follows the edge of a wood for about a mile.

senses.definition_vi: đi theo cùng hướng với thứ gì đó hoặc song song với thứ gì đó.

senses.definition: to be the logical result of something

examples.x: I don't see how that follows from what you've just said.
Several conclusions follow on from his statement.
If a = b and b = c it follows that a = c.
It does not necessarily follow that sleep loss would cause these symptoms.

senses.definition_vi: là kết quả logic của một điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to understand an explanation or the meaning of something

examples.x: Sorry, I don't follow.
Do you follow me?
I couldn't really follow his argument.
The plot is almost impossible to follow.
to be easy/difficult/hard to follow

senses.definition_vi: hiểu một lời giải thích hoặc ý nghĩa của một điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to watch or listen to somebody/something very carefully

examples.x: The children were following every word of the story intently.
Her eyes followed him everywhere (= she was looking at him all the time).

senses.definition_vi: quan sát hoặc lắng nghe ai đó/thứ gì đó rất cẩn thận.

senses.definition: to take an active interest in something and be aware of what is happening; to support a sports team

examples.x: We've been following this story for months.
Have you been following the basketball championships?
Millions of people followed the trial on TV.
In his leisure time he follows West Ham United.

senses.definition_vi: quan tâm tích cực đến một điều gì đó và nhận thức được những gì đang xảy ra; ủng hộ một đội thể thao.

senses.definition: to choose to regularly see content from a person, company, etc. using a social media service

examples.x: I don’t follow many celebrities on Instagram any more.

senses.definition_vi: chọn xem nội dung từ một người, công ty, v.v. một cách thường xuyên bằng cách sử dụng dịch vụ mạng xã hội.

senses.definition: to be about the life or development of somebody/something

examples.x: The novel follows the fortunes of a village community in Scotland.

senses.definition_vi: về cuộc sống hoặc sự phát triển của ai đó/thứ gì đó.

senses.definition: to develop or happen in a particular way

examples.x: The day followed the usual pattern.

senses.definition_vi: phát triển hoặc xảy ra theo một cách cụ thể.

senses.definition: to do the same job, have the same style of life, etc. as somebody else, especially somebody in your family

examples.x: She works in television, following in her father's footsteps.
He wanted to follow in his mother's footsteps and be a ballroom dancer.

senses.definition_vi: làm cùng một công việc, có cùng lối sống, v.v. như người khác, đặc biệt là người trong gia đình bạn.

senses.definition: to be guided by your sense of smell
senses.definition_vi: được hướng dẫn bởi khứu giác của bạn.

senses.definition: to go straight forward

examples.x: The garage is a mile ahead up the hill—just follow your nose.

senses.definition_vi: đi thẳng về phía trước.

senses.definition: to act according to what seems right or reasonable, rather than following any particular rules
senses.definition_vi: hành động theo những gì có vẻ đúng hoặc hợp lý, thay vì tuân theo bất kỳ quy tắc cụ thể nào.

senses.definition: to play a card of the same suit that has just been played
senses.definition_vi: chơi một lá bài cùng chất vừa được đánh ra.

senses.definition: to act or behave in the way that somebody else has just done
senses.definition_vi: hành động hoặc cư xử theo cách mà người khác vừa làm.

senses.definition: a person or event that is so good or successful at something that it will be difficult for anyone/anything else coming after them to be as good or successful

examples.x: She has been an excellent principal and will be a hard act to follow.
Their contribution will prove a tough act to follow.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc sự kiện xuất sắc hoặc thành công đến mức sẽ rất khó để bất kỳ ai/thứ gì khác đến sau họ có thể đạt được như vậy.

senses.definition: that is/are going to be mentioned next

examples.x: Answer the following questions.
The following article was written in 2017.

senses.definition_vi: sẽ được đề cập tiếp theo.

senses.definition: next in time

examples.x: the following afternoon/month/year/week
They arrived on Monday evening and we got there the following day.
In the following nights, Lucy slept poorly.

senses.definition_vi: tiếp theo về thời gian.

senses.definition: a wind blowing in the same direction as a ship or other vehicle that helps it move faster

examples.x: With a generous following wind, we sped across the lake.
With a bit of luck and a following wind, the project will be completed on schedule.

senses.definition_vi: một cơn gió thổi cùng hướng với tàu hoặc phương tiện khác giúp nó di chuyển nhanh hơn.

senses.definition: the thing or things that you will mention next; the person or people that you will mention next

examples.x: The following is a summary of events.
The following have been chosen to take part: Watts, Hodges and Lennox.
Your report must include the following: the artist's name and the title of the song.

senses.definition_vi: những điều hoặc người sẽ được đề cập tiếp theo.

senses.definition: a group of supporters

examples.x: The band has a huge following in Italy.
to attract a loyal/devoted following
The series enjoys a cult following among young people.

senses.definition_vi: một nhóm những người ủng hộ.

senses.definition: after or as a result of a particular event

examples.x: He took charge of the family business following his father's death.

senses.definition_vi: sau hoặc như là kết quả của một sự kiện cụ thể.

senses.definition: having warm or loving feelings for somebody, especially somebody you have known for a long time

examples.x: Over the years, I have grown quite fond of her.
I’ve always been very fond of your mother.

senses.definition_vi: có tình cảm ấm áp hoặc yêu thương đối với ai đó, đặc biệt là người mà bạn đã biết từ lâu.

senses.definition: finding something pleasant, especially something you have liked or enjoyed for a long time

examples.x: fond of music/cooking
We had grown fond of the house and didn't want to leave.

senses.definition_vi: thấy điều gì đó dễ chịu, đặc biệt là điều gì đó bạn đã thích hoặc tận hưởng trong một thời gian dài.

senses.definition: liking to do something that other people find annoying or unpleasant, and doing it often

examples.x: Sheila's very fond of telling other people what to do.
He's rather too fond of the sound of his own voice (= he talks too much).

senses.short_meaning_vi: thích làm điều gây khó chịu
senses.definition_vi: thích làm điều gì đó mà người khác thấy phiền hoặc khó chịu, và thường xuyên làm vậy

senses.definition: kind and loving

examples.x: a fond look/embrace/farewell
She waved a fond farewell to her parents and sister.
I have very fond memories of my time in Spain (= I remember it with affection and pleasure).

senses.definition_vi: tử tế và yêu thương

senses.definition: a hope about something that is not likely to happen

examples.x: I waited all day in the fond hope that she would change her mind.

senses.definition_vi: một hy vọng về điều gì đó khó có thể xảy ra

senses.definition: things that people or animals eat

examples.x: Pat had prepared food and drink for the work party.
to grow/cook/serve/eat food
Do you like Italian food?
Demand for organic food has been growing fast.
Families that eat together consume healthier food.
the food industry
People worry about food safety (= if food is safe to eat).
steps to protect the nation's food supply
Global food shortages and crop failures would have a devastating effect.
baby food (= prepared especially for babies)
cat/dog/pet food (= for a cat/dog/pet to eat)
You should eat more fresh foods.
The store specializes in frozen foods.

senses.definition_vi: những thứ mà con người hoặc động vật ăn

senses.definition: an idea that makes you think seriously and carefully

examples.x: The programme certainly provides plenty of food for thought.

senses.definition_vi: một ý tưởng khiến bạn suy nghĩ nghiêm túc và cẩn thận

senses.definition: not wanting to eat anything

examples.x: He's been off his food all week.

senses.definition_vi: không muốn ăn bất cứ thứ gì

senses.definition: a person who you think behaves or speaks in a way that lacks intelligence or good judgement

examples.x: Don't be such a fool!
I felt a fool when I realized my mistake.
He told me he was an actor and I was fool enough to believe him.

senses.definition_vi: một người mà bạn cho là hành động hoặc nói năng thiếu thông minh hoặc phán đoán tốt

examples.x: court fools who used to provide entertainment in the royal court

senses.definition_vi: (trong quá khứ) một người đàn ông được vua hoặc nữ hoàng thuê để mua vui cho mọi người bằng cách kể chuyện cười, hát hò, v.v.

senses.definition: a cold light dessert (= a sweet dish) made from fruit that is cooked to make it soft and mixed with cream or custard

examples.x: rhubarb fool

senses.definition_vi: một món tráng miệng lạnh (= món ngọt) làm từ trái cây được nấu mềm và trộn với kem hoặc sữa trứng

senses.definition: to behave in a stupid way in order to make people laugh, especially in a way that may also annoy them

examples.x: Quit playing the fool and get some work done!

senses.definition_vi: hành động một cách ngu ngốc để làm mọi người cười, đặc biệt là theo cách có thể làm phiền họ

senses.definition: used to say that something is very easy to do

examples.x: Any fool could tell she was lying.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng điều gì đó rất dễ làm

senses.definition: to be too intelligent or know too much about something to be tricked by other people

examples.x: She's nobody's fool when it comes to dealing with difficult patients.
She's nobody's fool. She had the car checked by a mechanic before buying it.

senses.short_meaning_vi: quá khôn ngoan để bị lừa
senses.definition_vi: quá thông minh hoặc biết quá nhiều về điều gì đó để bị người khác lừa

senses.definition: a person who is not sensible usually spends money too quickly or carelessly, or is cheated by others
senses.definition_vi: một người không khôn ngoan, thường tiêu tiền quá nhanh hoặc bất cẩn, hoặc bị người khác lừa gạt

senses.definition: people with little experience try to do the difficult or dangerous things that more experienced people would not consider doing
senses.definition_vi: những người có ít kinh nghiệm cố gắng làm những việc khó khăn hoặc nguy hiểm mà những người có kinh nghiệm hơn sẽ không xem xét làm

senses.definition: to say or do something deliberately so that people will think that somebody is stupid

examples.x: Can't you see she's making a fool of you?
I will not be made a fool of like this.
She was angry at having been made a fool of.

senses.short_meaning_vi: làm cho ai đó trông ngốc
senses.definition_vi: cố tình nói hoặc làm điều gì đó để mọi người nghĩ rằng ai đó ngốc

senses.definition: to do something stupid that makes other people think that you are a fool

examples.x: I made a complete fool of myself in front of everyone!

senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó ngu ngốc khiến người khác nghĩ rằng bạn là kẻ ngốc

senses.definition: used to say that you think that somebody was stupid to do something, especially when it causes them problems

examples.x: ‘Someone's bumped my car!’ ‘More fool you for parking it there.’
‘I know I shouldn’t have given him the money, but I did.’ ‘More fool you!’
I thought it was safe to leave my suitcase there. More fool me.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn nghĩ ai đó thật ngu ngốc khi làm điều gì đó, đặc biệt là khi điều đó gây ra vấn đề cho họ

senses.definition: an older person who behaves in a stupid way is worse than a younger person who does the same thing, because experience should have taught him or her not to do it
senses.short_meaning_vi: người già hành động ngu ngốc
senses.definition_vi: một người lớn tuổi hành động ngu ngốc thì tệ hơn một người trẻ tuổi làm điều tương tự, bởi vì kinh nghiệm lẽ ra phải dạy họ không nên làm vậy

senses.definition: to be very impatient with people that you think are stupid

examples.x: She was a forceful personality who didn't suffer fools gladly.

senses.short_meaning_vi: thiếu kiên nhẫn với kẻ ngốc
senses.definition_vi: rất thiếu kiên nhẫn với những người bạn cho là ngu ngốc

senses.definition: the lowest part of the leg, below the ankle, on which a person or an animal stands

examples.x: My feet are aching.

He's broken several bones in his left foot.

to leap/jump/spring to your feet (= to stand up quickly and easily)
to scramble/struggle/stagger to your feet (= to stand up slowly and with difficulty)
We came on foot (= we walked).
I've been on my feet (= standing or walking around) all day.
Come on lads—on your feet and do some work!
walking around the house in bare feet (= not wearing shoes or socks)
We were stamping our feet (= hitting them on the ground) to keep warm.
Please wipe your feet (= your shoes) on the mat.
The hot sand burned the soles of my feet.
He is currently resting a foot injury.
a foot pump (= operated using your foot, not your hand)
a foot passenger (= one who travels on a ferry without a car)

senses.definition_vi: phần dưới cùng của chân, dưới mắt cá chân, nơi con người hoặc động vật đứng

senses.definition: having or using the type or number of foot/feet mentioned

examples.x: bare-footed
four-footed
a left-footed shot into the corner

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc sử dụng loại hoặc số lượng chân được đề cập

senses.definition: the part of a sock, stocking, etc. that covers the foot
senses.definition_vi: phần của tất, bít tất, v.v. bao phủ bàn chân

senses.definition: a unit for measuring length equal to 12 inches or 30.48 centimetres

examples.x: a six-foot high wall
We're flying at 35 000 feet.
‘How tall are you?’ ‘Five foot nine (= five feet and nine inches).’
The town was under several feet of water (= the water was several feet deep).
We had over a foot of snow in a few hours (= the snow was over a foot deep).
The store has 600 square feet of retail space.

senses.definition_vi: một đơn vị đo chiều dài bằng 12 inch hoặc 30,48 centimet

senses.definition: the lowest part of something; the base or bottom of something

examples.x: The city now reaches to the foot of the surrounding mountains.
At the foot of the stairs she turned to face him.
See the foot of this page for a partial bibliography.
The team remains stuck at the foot of the table (= with fewer points than all the other teams).

senses.definition_vi: phần dưới cùng của một cái gì đó; phần đế hoặc đáy của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the further or lower end of something

examples.x: The nurse hung a chart at the foot of the bed (= the part of the bed where your feet normally are when you are lying in it).
He sat at the foot of the table.

senses.definition_vi: phần xa hơn hoặc thấp hơn của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a unit of rhythm in a line of poetry containing one stressed syllable and one or more syllables without stress. Each of the four divisions in the following line is a foot

examples.x: For men / may come / and men / may go.

senses.definition_vi: một đơn vị nhịp điệu trong một dòng thơ chứa một âm tiết nhấn và một hoặc nhiều âm tiết không nhấn. Mỗi một trong bốn phần của dòng sau là một foot

senses.definition: to be extremely busy; to have too many things to do

examples.x: Weekdays are slow in the restaurant, but at weekends the staff are rushed off their feet.

senses.definition_vi: cực kỳ bận rộn; có quá nhiều việc phải làm

senses.definition: to tie somebody’s hands and feet together so that they cannot move or escape
senses.definition_vi: trói chặt tay chân của ai đó để họ không thể di chuyển hoặc trốn thoát

senses.definition: to prevent somebody from doing what they want by creating rules, limits, etc.
senses.definition_vi: ngăn cản ai đó làm những gì họ muốn bằng cách tạo ra các quy tắc, giới hạn, v.v.

senses.definition: used to say that a situation has changed so that somebody now has power or authority over the person who used to have power or authority over them
senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng tình huống đã thay đổi để ai đó giờ đây có quyền lực hoặc thẩm quyền đối với người trước đây có quyền lực hoặc thẩm quyền đối với họ

senses.definition: to suddenly cause somebody’s idea or plan to fail by doing something to stop them from continuing with it
senses.definition_vi: đột ngột làm ý tưởng hoặc kế hoạch của ai đó thất bại bằng cách làm điều gì đó để ngăn họ tiếp tục

senses.definition: to be deliberately slow in doing something or in making a decision

senses.definition: to be lucky in finding yourself in a good situation, or in getting out of a difficult situation

examples.x: You landed on your feet, getting such a well-paid job with so little experience.
Jim’s always getting himself in trouble, but he usually seems to fall on his feet.

senses.short_meaning_vi: may mắn tìm được tình huống tốt

senses.definition: with your feet touching the ground before any other part of your body

examples.x: He landed feet first.

senses.definition_vi: với chân chạm đất trước bất kỳ bộ phận nào khác của cơ thể

examples.x: You'll have to carry me out feet first!

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn rời khỏi một nơi với hai chân về phía trước, bạn sẽ được mang ra ngoài sau khi chết

senses.definition: to become able to act independently and with confidence

examples.x: I only recently joined the firm so I'm still finding my feet.

senses.short_meaning_vi: tự tin hành động độc lập

senses.definition_vi: một cách mạnh mẽ để nói rằng bạn hoàn toàn không đồng ý với những gì vừa được nói

senses.definition: covering your whole body

senses.definition_vi: che phủ toàn bộ cơ thể của bạn

examples.x: He was going to ask her but he got cold feet and said nothing.

senses.definition_vi: đột nhiên trở nên lo lắng về việc làm điều gì đó mà bạn đã lên kế hoạch

senses.definition: to start doing something that is new for you

examples.x: At that time he was a young actor, just getting his feet wet.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu làm điều gì đó mới đối với bạn

senses.definition: to manage to enter an organization, a field of business, etc. that could bring you success

examples.x: I always wanted to work in TV but it took me two years to get a foot in the door.

senses.definition_vi: để quản lý để vào một tổ chức, một lĩnh vực kinh doanh, v.v. có thể mang lại thành công cho bạn

senses.definition: to want to travel or move to a different place; to want to do something different

senses.definition: to work together in order to achieve a shared aim

examples.x: The two firms joined forces to win the contract.
The two companies have joined forces to form a new consortium.

senses.definition_vi: làm việc cùng nhau để đạt được một mục tiêu chung

senses.definition: a person or group that no longer has any power or influence

examples.x: The opposition party is now a spent political force.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc nhóm không còn sức mạnh hoặc ảnh hưởng nào nữa

senses.definition: to make somebody do something that they do not want to do

examples.x: The President was forced into resigning.
The President was forced to resign.
I was forced to take a taxi because the last bus had left.
The rebel leader was forced to flee for his life.
She forced herself to be polite to them.
He was forced into exile with his family.
Ill health forced him into early retirement.
Residents were forced out of their homes.
The high cost of insurance is forcing some out of business.
He didn't force me—I wanted to go.
‘I shouldn't really have any more.’ ‘Go on—force yourself!’
Public pressure eventually forced a change in the government's position.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó làm điều gì đó mà họ không muốn làm

senses.definition: to use physical strength to move somebody/something into a particular position

examples.x: to force a lock/window/door (= to break it open using force)
Someone had tried to force (an) entry (= to enter the building using force).
She forced her way through the crowd of reporters.
He tried to force a copy of his book into my hand.
The door had been forced open.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng sức mạnh thể chất để di chuyển ai đó/cái gì đó vào một vị trí cụ thể

senses.definition: to make something happen, especially before other people are ready

examples.x: He was in a position where he had to force a decision.
Building a new road here will force house prices down.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho điều gì đó xảy ra, đặc biệt là trước khi những người khác sẵn sàng

senses.definition: to make yourself smile, laugh, etc. rather than doing it naturally

examples.x: She managed to force a smile.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho bản thân mỉm cười, cười, v.v., thay vì làm điều đó một cách tự nhiên

senses.definition: to make fruit, plants, etc. grow or develop faster than normal by keeping them in special conditions

examples.x: forced rhubarb
It is unwise to force a child's talent.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho trái cây, cây cối, v.v., phát triển hoặc phát triển nhanh hơn bình thường bằng cách giữ chúng trong điều kiện đặc biệt

senses.definition: to try to force somebody to listen to and accept your opinions in a way that they find annoying

examples.x: People are sick of having advertising rammed down their throats.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng ép ai đó lắng nghe và chấp nhận ý kiến của bạn theo cách mà họ thấy khó chịu

senses.definition: to make somebody do something that they do not want to do or make them do it sooner than they had intended

examples.x: They decided to strike to force the management’s hand.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó làm điều gì đó mà họ không muốn làm hoặc làm cho họ làm điều đó sớm hơn dự định

senses.definition: to do something to make people take a decision quickly
senses.definition_vi: làm cho mọi người đưa ra quyết định một cách nhanh chóng

senses.definition: to run very fast in a race in order to make the other people taking part run faster
senses.definition_vi: chạy rất nhanh trong một cuộc đua để làm cho những người tham gia khác chạy nhanh hơn

senses.definition: to make somebody do something faster than they want to

examples.x: The demonstrations have succeeded in forcing the pace of change.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó làm điều gì đó nhanh hơn họ muốn

senses.definition: a statement about what will happen in the future, based on information that is available now

examples.x: The sales forecasts are encouraging.
It is difficult to make long-term forecasts for a fast-growing industry.
The forecast said there would be sunny intervals and showers.
The shipping forecast gave warnings of gales.

senses.definition_vi: một tuyên bố về những gì sẽ xảy ra trong tương lai, dựa trên thông tin có sẵn ngay bây giờ

senses.definition: to say what you think will happen in the future based on information that you have now

examples.x: Experts are forecasting a recovery in the economy.
Snow is forecast for tomorrow.
It is difficult to forecast the demand for the new train service.
Temperatures were forecast to reach 40°C.
The report forecasts that prices will rise by 3% next month.
It is difficult to forecast how the markets will react.

senses.definition_vi: nói những gì bạn nghĩ sẽ xảy ra trong tương lai dựa trên thông tin bạn có bây giờ

senses.definition: in or from a country that is not your own

examples.x: What foreign languages do you speak?
It can be a challenge at first living in a foreign country.
I went to the bank to get some foreign currency.
a foreign-owned company
foreign holidays
He spoke with a foreign accent.

senses.definition_vi: ở hoặc từ một quốc gia không phải là của bạn

senses.definition: dealing with or involving other countries

examples.x: This is a huge departure for the country's foreign policy.
The country relies heavily on foreign aid.
The area is trying to attract foreign investment.
Iran's foreign ministry
the Japanese foreign minister
a foreign correspondent (= one who reports on foreign countries in newspapers or on television)

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến hoặc bao gồm các quốc gia khác

senses.definition: not typical of somebody/something; not known to somebody/something and therefore seeming strange

examples.x: Dishonesty is foreign to his nature.
This kind of attitude is completely foreign to her.

senses.definition_vi: không điển hình của ai đó/cái gì đó; không quen thuộc với ai đó/cái gì đó và do đó có vẻ kỳ lạ

senses.definition: an object that has entered something by accident and should not be there

examples.x: Tears help to protect the eye from potentially harmful foreign bodies.

senses.definition_vi: một vật thể đã đi vào bên trong một vật khác do tai nạn và không nên có ở đó

senses.definition: a person who comes from a different country

examples.x: The fact that I was a foreigner was a big disadvantage.

senses.definition_vi: một người đến từ một quốc gia khác

senses.definition: a person who does not belong in a particular place

examples.x: I have always been regarded as a foreigner by the local folk.

senses.definition_vi: một người không thuộc về một nơi cụ thể

senses.definition: a large area of land that is thickly covered with trees

examples.x: a tropical/pine forest
One careless match can start a forest fire.
Thousands of hectares of forest are destroyed each year.
the forest floor/canopy

senses.definition_vi: một khu vực đất rộng lớn được bao phủ dày đặc bởi cây cối

senses.definition: a mass of tall narrow objects that are close together

examples.x: a forest of cranes on the skyline

senses.definition_vi: một khối các vật thể cao, hẹp, gần nhau

senses.definition: to not see or understand the main point about something, because you are paying too much attention to small details
senses.definition_vi: không nhìn thấy hoặc không hiểu điểm chính về điều gì đó, vì bạn đang chú ý quá nhiều đến các chi tiết nhỏ

senses.definition: used to say that a particular situation or state will always exist

examples.x: I'll love you forever!
After her death, their lives changed forever.
Just keep telling yourself that it won't last forever.
The local dairy industry will soon be lost forever.
The final death toll may forever remain a mystery.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng một tình huống hoặc trạng thái cụ thể sẽ luôn tồn tại

senses.definition: a very long time

examples.x: It takes her forever to get dressed.
Where have you been? I've been waiting forever!

senses.definition_vi: một thời gian rất dài

senses.definition: used with verbs in the progressive tenses to say that somebody does something very often and in a way that is annoying to other people

examples.x: She's forever going on about how poor they are.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với các động từ ở thì tiếp diễn để nói rằng ai đó làm điều gì đó rất thường xuyên và theo cách gây khó chịu cho người khác

senses.definition: to put a lot of effort into making something successful or strong so that it will last

examples.x: a move to forge new links between management and workers
Strategic alliances are being forged with major European companies.
She forged a new career in the music business.
They forged a lead in the first 30 minutes of the game.

senses.definition_vi: đặt nhiều nỗ lực vào việc làm cho điều gì đó thành công hoặc mạnh mẽ để nó sẽ kéo dài

senses.definition: to make an illegal copy of something in order to cheat people

examples.x: to forge a passport/banknote/document
He's getting good at forging his mother's signature.
New digital techniques can spot paintings that have been forged.

senses.definition_vi: tạo ra một bản sao bất hợp pháp của một cái gì đó để lừa đảo mọi người

senses.definition: to shape metal by heating it in a fire and hitting it with a hammer; to make an object in this way

examples.x: swords forged from steel

senses.definition_vi: định hình kim loại bằng cách nung nóng nó trong lửa và dùng búa đập vào nó; tạo ra một vật thể theo cách này

senses.definition: to move forward in a steady but powerful way

examples.x: He forged through the crowds to the front of the stage.
She forged into the lead (= in a competition, race, etc.).

senses.definition_vi: tiến về phía trước một cách ổn định nhưng mạnh mẽ

senses.definition: to not remember to do something that you ought to do, or to bring or buy something that you ought to bring or buy

examples.x: ‘Why weren't you at the meeting?’ ‘Sorry—I forgot.’
In the excitement I forgot all about my little brother.
Take care, and don't forget to write.
He forgot to mention he was bringing a guest.
I forgot to ask him for his address.
I forgot my purse (= I did not remember to bring it).
‘Hey, don't forget me!’ (= don't leave without me)
Aren't you forgetting something? (= I think you have forgotten to do something)

senses.definition_vi: không nhớ làm điều gì đó mà bạn nên làm, hoặc mang hoặc mua thứ gì đó mà bạn nên mang hoặc mua

senses.definition: to be unable to remember something that has happened in the past or information that you knew in the past

examples.x: Oh, I almost forgot—there was a call for you.
I'd completely forgotten about the money he owed me.
I never forget a face.
I've forgotten my user name.
Who could forget his speech at last year's party?
She keeps forgetting (that) I’m not a child any more.
I was forgetting (= I had forgotten) (that) you’ve been here before.
It is easy to forget that not all countries have these advantages.
I've forgotten where they live exactly.
I forget how much they paid for it.
I'll never forget hearing this piece of music for the first time.
I'll never forget him sobbing uncontrollably at the funeral.
It should not be forgotten that people used to get much more exercise.

senses.definition_vi: không thể nhớ điều gì đó đã xảy ra trong quá khứ hoặc thông tin mà bạn đã biết trong quá khứ

senses.definition: to deliberately stop thinking about somebody/something

examples.x: Try to forget about what happened.
Could you possibly forget about work for five minutes?
Forget him!
Let's forget our differences and be friends.
Forget glasses; soon your computer display will correct your vision.
Let's forget last night, shall we?
Forget (that) I said anything!
Forget what you've heard in the past.

senses.definition_vi: cố tình ngừng suy nghĩ về ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to stop thinking that something is a possibility

examples.x: If I lose this job, we can forget about buying a new car.
‘I was hoping you might be able to lend me the money.’ ‘You can forget that!’

senses.definition_vi: ngừng nghĩ rằng điều gì đó là có thể

senses.definition: to behave in a way that is not socially acceptable

examples.x: I'm forgetting myself. I haven't offered you a drink yet!

senses.definition_vi: hành xử theo cách không chấp nhận được về mặt xã hội

senses.definition: used to tell somebody how they should behave, especially when they have been behaving in a way you do not like

examples.x: You're a suspect, not a detective, and don't you forget it.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói với ai đó cách họ nên cư xử, đặc biệt là khi họ đã cư xử theo cách bạn không thích

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that something is not important and that they should not worry about it

examples.x: ‘I still owe you for lunch yesterday.’ ‘Forget it.’

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói với ai đó rằng điều gì đó không quan trọng và họ không nên lo lắng về nó

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that you are not going to repeat what you said

examples.x: ‘Now, what were you saying about John?’ ‘Forget it, it doesn't matter.’

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói với ai đó rằng bạn sẽ không lặp lại những gì mình đã nói

senses.definition: used to emphasize that you are saying ‘no’ to something

examples.x: ‘Any chance of you helping out here?’ ‘Forget it, I've got too much to do.’

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng bạn đang nói 'không' với điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to tell somebody to stop talking about something because they are annoying you

examples.x: Just forget it, will you!

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói với ai đó ngừng nói về điều gì đó vì họ đang làm bạn khó chịu

senses.definition: to stop feeling angry with somebody for something they have done to you and to behave as if it had not happened

examples.x: I know what he did was wrong but don’t you think it’s time to forgive and forget?

senses.definition_vi: ngừng cảm thấy tức giận với ai đó vì điều họ đã làm với bạn và cư xử như thể điều đó chưa từng xảy ra

senses.definition: used to include something in the list of things that you have just mentioned

examples.x: I share the house with Jim, Ian and Sam, not forgetting Spike, the dog.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để bao gồm điều gì đó vào danh sách những điều bạn vừa đề cập

senses.definition: to stop feeling angry with somebody who has done something to harm, annoy or upset you; to stop feeling angry with yourself

examples.x: Can you ever forgive me?
I'd never forgive myself if she heard the truth from someone else.
I'll never forgive her for what she did.
She never forgave him for losing her ring.
I can't forgive that type of behaviour.
We all have to learn to forgive.
She'd forgive him anything.

senses.definition_vi: ngừng cảm thấy tức giận với ai đó đã làm tổn hại, gây khó chịu hoặc làm bạn buồn; ngừng cảm thấy tức giận với chính mình

senses.definition: used to say in a polite way that you are sorry if what you are doing or saying seems rude or silly

examples.x: Forgive me, but I don't see that any of this concerns me.
Forgive me for interrupting, but I really don't agree with that.
Forgive my ignorance, but what exactly does the company do?
Forgive my interrupting but I really don't agree with that.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói một cách lịch sự rằng bạn xin lỗi nếu những gì bạn đang làm hoặc nói có vẻ thô lỗ hoặc ngớ ngẩn

senses.definition: to say that somebody does not need to pay back money that they have borrowed

examples.x: The government has agreed to forgive a large part of the debt.

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng ai đó không cần phải trả lại số tiền họ đã vay

senses.definition: used to say that it is easy to understand why somebody does or thinks something, although they are wrong

examples.x: Looking at the crowds out shopping, you could be forgiven for thinking that everyone has plenty of money.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng thật dễ hiểu tại sao ai đó làm hoặc nghĩ điều gì đó, mặc dù họ sai

senses.definition: to stop feeling angry with somebody for something they have done to you and to behave as if it had not happened

examples.x: I know what he did was wrong but don’t you think it’s time to forgive and forget?
He was not the sort of man to forgive and forget.

senses.definition_vi: ngừng cảm thấy tức giận với ai đó vì điều họ đã làm với bạn và cư xử như thể điều đó chưa từng xảy ra

senses.definition: a tool with a handle and three or four sharp points (called prongs), used for picking up and eating food

examples.x: to eat with a knife and fork
Mash the mixture with a fork.

senses.definition_vi: một dụng cụ có tay cầm và ba hoặc bốn đầu nhọn (gọi là răng), dùng để gắp và ăn thức ăn

senses.definition: a garden tool with a long or short handle and three or four sharp metal points, used for digging
senses.definition_vi: một dụng cụ làm vườn có tay cầm dài hoặc ngắn và ba hoặc bốn đầu kim loại sắc nhọn, dùng để đào

senses.definition: a place where a road, river, etc. divides into two parts; either of these two parts

examples.x: Take the right fork.
Shortly before dusk they reached a fork and took the left-hand track.
Bear left at the fork in the road.

senses.definition_vi: một nơi mà đường, sông, v.v. chia thành hai phần; một trong hai phần đó

senses.definition: a thing that is like a fork in shape, with two or more long parts

examples.x: a jagged fork of lightning
a monkey sitting in the fork of the tree

senses.definition_vi: một vật có hình dạng giống như nĩa, có hai hoặc nhiều phần dài

senses.definition: either of two metal supporting pieces into which a wheel on a bicycle or motorcycle is fitted
senses.definition_vi: một trong hai bộ phận đỡ bằng kim loại mà bánh xe trên xe đạp hoặc xe máy được lắp vào

senses.definition: a type or variety of something

examples.x: all the millions of different life forms on the planet today
forms of transport/government/entertainment
one of the most common forms of cancer
Swimming is one of the best forms of exercise.
Along with talking and singing, drawing must be the oldest form of communication.

senses.definition_vi: một loại hoặc biến thể của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a way of writing or saying a word that shows, for example, if it is plural or in a particular tense

examples.x: the infinitive form of the verb

senses.definition_vi: một cách viết hoặc nói một từ cho biết, ví dụ, liệu nó là số nhiều hay ở một thì cụ thể

senses.definition: the particular way something is, seems, looks or is presented

examples.x: The disease can take several different forms.
The training programme takes the form of a series of workshops.
We need to come to some form of agreement.
Help in the form of money will be very welcome.
Help arrived in the form of two police officers.
Most political questions involve morality in some form or other.
We prefer applications in electronic form.
Many collections of his cartoons appeared in book form.
Success can come in many forms.
I'm opposed to censorship in any shape or form.

senses.definition_vi: cách thức cụ thể mà một cái gì đó là, có vẻ, trông hoặc được trình bày

senses.definition: an official document containing questions and spaces for answers

examples.x: an application/entry/order form
to fill in a form
to fill out a form
I filled in/out a form on their website.
to complete a form
We asked them to read and sign consent forms.
a booking form
a reservation form

senses.definition_vi: một tài liệu chính thức chứa các câu hỏi và khoảng trống để trả lời

senses.definition: the shape of somebody/something; a person or thing of which only the shape can be seen

examples.x: The human form has changed little over the last 30 000 years.
Two weeks later the moth will emerge in its adult form.
They made out a shadowy form in front of them.

senses.definition_vi: hình dạng của ai đó/điều gì đó; một người hoặc vật mà chỉ có thể nhìn thấy hình dạng

senses.definition: the arrangement of parts in a whole, especially in a work of art or piece of writing

examples.x: Shape and form are of greater importance to me than colour.
In a novel, form and content are equally important.

senses.definition_vi: sự sắp xếp các bộ phận trong một tổng thể, đặc biệt là trong một tác phẩm nghệ thuật hoặc văn bản

senses.definition: how fit and healthy somebody is; the state of being fit and healthy

examples.x: After six months' training the whole team is in superb form.
I really need to get back in form.
The horse was clearly out of form.

senses.definition_vi: mức độ khỏe mạnh và lành mạnh của ai đó; trạng thái khỏe mạnh và lành mạnh

senses.definition: how well somebody/something is performing; the fact that somebody/something is performing well

examples.x: Midfielder Elliott has shown disappointing form recently.
She signalled her return to form with a convincing victory.
When she's on form, nobody in the world is funnier.
The whole team was on good form and deserved the win.
On current/present form the party is heading for another election victory.
She was in great form (= happy and cheerful and full of energy) at the wedding party.

senses.definition_vi: mức độ hoạt động tốt của ai đó/điều gì đó; việc ai đó/điều gì đó hoạt động tốt

senses.definition: the usual way of doing something

examples.x: What's the form when you apply for a research grant?
conventional social forms
True to form (= as he usually does) he arrived an hour late.
Partners of employees are invited as a matter of form (= because that is the usual way things are done).

senses.definition_vi: cách làm thông thường của một điều gì đó

senses.definition: the way of doing things that is socially acceptable/not socially acceptable

examples.x: When I was a boy it was always considered bad form to talk about food or money.
Good form dictated that she should dress more casually in the country.

senses.definition_vi: cách làm những điều được chấp nhận/không được chấp nhận về mặt xã hội

senses.definition: a class in a school

examples.x: Who's your form teacher?

senses.definition_vi: một lớp học trong trường

senses.definition: a student in the form mentioned at school

examples.x: a third-former

senses.definition_vi: một học sinh trong lớp được đề cập ở trường

senses.definition: of any type

examples.x: I don't approve of violence in any shape or form.
I can't stand insects in any shape or form.
I do not condone bullying in any way, shape or form.

senses.definition_vi: thuộc bất kỳ loại nào

senses.definition: to gradually form into a particular shape; to gradually develop

examples.x: In her body a new life was taking form.

senses.definition_vi: dần dần hình thành thành một hình dạng cụ thể; dần dần phát triển

senses.definition: to produce something in a particular way or make it have a particular shape

examples.x: Bend the wire so that it forms a ‘V’.
Rearrange the letters to form a new word.
Games can help children learn to form letters.
Do you know how to form the past tense?
Form the dough into balls with your hands.
The chain is formed from 136 links.
The table was formed of two large slabs of stone.

senses.definition_vi: sản xuất một cái gì đó theo một cách cụ thể hoặc làm cho nó có một hình dạng cụ thể

senses.definition: to move or arrange objects or people so that they are in a group with a particular shape; to become arranged in a group like this

examples.x: First get students to form groups of four.
to form a line/queue/circle
Queues were already forming outside the theatre.
The teams formed up into lines.
Everyone formed into a circle.
The regiment was formed into ranks on a nearby lane.
