senses.definition_vi: một lớp đá, bê tông, v.v. tạo thành nền móng vững chắc dưới lòng đất của một tòa nhà

senses.definition: a skin-coloured cream that is put on the face under other make-up
senses.definition_vi: một loại kem màu da được thoa lên mặt trước các lớp trang điểm khác

senses.definition: to cause people to question their basic beliefs about something

examples.x: This issue has shaken the foundations of French politics.
an event which rocked the foundations of British politics
The scandal rocked the legal establishment to its foundations.

senses.definition_vi: khiến mọi người đặt câu hỏi về những niềm tin cơ bản của họ về một điều gì đó

senses.definition: a person who starts an organization, institution, etc. or causes something to be built

examples.x: the founder and president of the company
a wife and husband who are joint founders of the company

senses.definition_vi: một người bắt đầu một tổ chức, thể chế, v.v. hoặc gây dựng nên một cái gì đó

examples.x: There are only four cookies left.
four of Sweden’s top financial experts
Ten people were invited but only four turned up.
Can you lend me four dollars?
a four-month contract
Look at page four.
Five and four is nine.
Three fours are twelve.
I can't read your writing—is this meant to be a four?
The bulbs are planted in threes or fours (= groups of three or four).
We moved to America when I was four (= four years old).
Shall we meet at four (= at four o'clock), then?

senses.definition: a group of four people or things

examples.x: to make up a four at tennis
a coach and four (= four horses)

senses.definition_vi: một nhóm bốn người hoặc vật

senses.definition: a hit that scores four runs (= points)
senses.definition_vi: một cú đánh ghi được bốn lần chạy (= điểm)

senses.definition: a team of four people who row a long narrow boat in races; the boat that they row
senses.definition_vi: một đội gồm bốn người chèo một chiếc thuyền dài hẹp trong các cuộc đua; chiếc thuyền mà họ chèo

senses.definition: bent over with hands and knees on the ground

examples.x: We were crawling around on all fours.

senses.definition_vi: cong người với hai tay và hai đầu gối trên mặt đất

senses.definition: used when you are talking about keeping something secret

examples.x: Don't let this go further than these four walls (= Don't tell anyone else who is not in the room now).

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang nói về việc giữ bí mật một điều gì đó

senses.definition: 4th

examples.x: Today is the fourth (of May).
the fourth century BC
It's her fourth birthday.
My office is on the fourth floor.
It's the fourth time that I've been to America.
Her mother had just given birth to another child, her fourth.
the world’s fourth-largest oil exporter
He finished fourth in the race.
Edward IV (= Edward the Fourth)

senses.definition_vi: thứ 4

senses.definition: a small part or amount of something

examples.x: Only a small fraction of a bank's total deposits will be withdrawn at any one time.
She hesitated for the merest fraction of a second.
He raised his voice a fraction.

senses.definition_vi: một phần nhỏ hoặc một lượng nhỏ của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a division of a number, for example ⅝

examples.x: How do you express 25% as a fraction?

senses.definition_vi: một phép chia của một số, ví dụ ⅝

senses.definition: a quantity of liquid that has been collected as a result of a process that separates the parts of a liquid mixture

examples.x: The third fraction contains alcohols with boiling points of 120–130℃.

senses.definition_vi: một lượng chất lỏng đã được thu thập như là kết quả của một quá trình tách các thành phần của hỗn hợp lỏng

senses.definition: easily broken or damaged

examples.x: fragile china/glass/bones
Be careful not to drop it; it’s very fragile.

senses.definition_vi: dễ bị vỡ hoặc hư hỏng

senses.definition: weak and uncertain; easy to destroy or harm

examples.x: a fragile alliance/ceasefire/relationship
The economy remains extremely fragile.
In her job she was used to dealing with actors’ fragile egos.
fragile habitats threatened by pollution

senses.definition_vi: yếu và không chắc chắn; dễ bị hủy diệt hoặc tổn hại

senses.definition: thin or light and often beautiful

examples.x: fragile beauty
The woman's fragile face broke into a smile.

senses.definition_vi: mỏng hoặc nhẹ và thường đẹp

senses.definition: not strong and likely to become ill

examples.x: Her father is now 86 and in fragile health.
I'm feeling a bit fragile after last night (= not well, perhaps because of drinking too much alcohol).

senses.definition_vi: không khỏe và có khả năng bị ốm

senses.definition: a small part of something that has broken off or comes from something larger

examples.x: Police found fragments of glass near the scene.
The shattered vase lay in fragments on the floor.

senses.definition_vi: một phần nhỏ của một cái gì đó đã bị vỡ ra hoặc đến từ một cái gì đó lớn hơn

senses.definition: a single part of something; a part that is not complete

examples.x: I overheard a fragment of their conversation.
She could recall only fragments of his poetry.

senses.definition_vi: một phần của một cái gì đó; một phần không hoàn chỉnh

senses.definition: a strong border or structure of wood, metal, etc. that holds a picture, door, piece of glass, etc. in position

examples.x: a picture/photo frame
aluminium window frames
I'm going to paint the door frame white.
She leaned against the frame of the door.
pictures in gold frames

senses.definition_vi: một đường viền hoặc cấu trúc chắc chắn bằng gỗ, kim loại, v.v. giữ một bức tranh, cửa, tấm kính, v.v. ở đúng vị trí

senses.definition: the supporting structure of a piece of furniture, a building, a vehicle, etc. that gives it its shape

examples.x: a bicycle frame
The bed frame is made of pine.
the frame of an aircraft/a car/a bicycle
In the 1920s, federal office buildings were typically built with steel frames encased in concrete or granite.

senses.definition_vi: cấu trúc hỗ trợ của một món đồ nội thất, tòa nhà, phương tiện, v.v. tạo nên hình dạng của nó

senses.definition: a structure of plastic or metal that holds the lenses in a pair of glasses

examples.x: gold-rimmed frames

senses.definition_vi: cấu trúc bằng nhựa hoặc kim loại giữ tròng kính trong một cặp kính

senses.definition: the form or structure of a person or animal’s body

examples.x: to have a small/slender/large frame
The bed was shorter than his six-foot frame.

senses.definition_vi: hình dáng hoặc cấu trúc của cơ thể người hoặc động vật

senses.definition: the general ideas or structure that form the background to something

examples.x: In this course we hope to look at literature in the frame of its social and historical context.

senses.definition_vi: những ý tưởng hoặc cấu trúc chung tạo thành bối cảnh cho một điều gì đó

senses.definition: one of the single photographs that a film or video is made of
senses.definition_vi: một trong những bức ảnh đơn lẻ tạo nên một bộ phim hoặc video

senses.definition: a single picture in a comic strip
senses.definition_vi: một hình ảnh đơn lẻ trong một dải truyện tranh

senses.definition: one of the separate areas on an internet page that you can scroll through (= read by moving the text up or down)
senses.definition_vi: một trong những khu vực riêng biệt trên một trang internet mà bạn có thể cuộn (= đọc bằng cách di chuyển văn bản lên hoặc xuống)

senses.definition: a small wooden or metal frame covered with glass that you grow seeds or small plants in to protect them from cold weather
senses.definition_vi: một khung gỗ hoặc kim loại nhỏ được phủ kính để trồng hạt giống hoặc cây nhỏ nhằm bảo vệ chúng khỏi thời tiết lạnh

senses.definition: a single section of play in the game of snooker, etc., or in bowling

examples.x: He won the first frame easily.

senses.definition_vi: một phần riêng biệt của một ván đấu trong trò chơi bi-a, v.v., hoặc trong bowling

senses.definition: be taking part/not taking part in something

examples.x: We won our match, so we're still in the frame for the championship.

senses.definition_vi: đang tham gia / không tham gia vào một điều gì đó

senses.definition: to be wanted/not wanted by the police because you are/are not suspected of having committed a crime

examples.x: He was always in the frame for the killing.

senses.definition_vi: đang bị cảnh sát truy tìm / không bị cảnh sát truy tìm vì bị nghi ngờ / không bị nghi ngờ phạm tội

senses.definition: to put or make a frame or border around something

examples.x: The photograph had been framed.
He was presented with a framed certificate.
mirrors framed in silver and gold

senses.definition_vi: đặt hoặc làm một khung hoặc đường viền xung quanh một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to surround something/somebody in a way that makes an attractive image

examples.x: I like the way your hair frames your face.
He stood there, head back, framed against the blue sky.

senses.definition_vi: bao quanh một cái gì đó / ai đó theo cách tạo ra một hình ảnh hấp dẫn

senses.definition: to produce false evidence against an innocent person so that people think they are guilty

examples.x: He says he was framed.
She found herself framed for murder.

senses.definition_vi: tạo bằng chứng giả chống lại một người vô tội để mọi người nghĩ rằng họ có tội

senses.definition: to create and develop something such as a plan, a system or a set of rules

examples.x: Measures to secure oil production must be framed in the context of rising energy demands.

senses.definition_vi: tạo ra và phát triển một cái gì đó như một kế hoạch, một hệ thống hoặc một bộ quy tắc

senses.definition: to express something in a particular way

examples.x: You'll have to be careful how you frame the question.

senses.definition_vi: diễn đạt một cái gì đó theo một cách cụ thể

senses.definition: the parts of a building or an object that support its weight and give it shape

examples.x: built on a wooden framework
The ship's elaborate metal framework was exposed.

senses.definition_vi: các bộ phận của tòa nhà hoặc vật thể chịu trọng lượng và tạo hình dạng cho nó

senses.definition: a set of beliefs, ideas or rules that is used as the basis for making judgements, decisions, etc.

examples.x: a theoretical/conceptual framework
The report provides a framework for further research.
We are currently exploring new approaches within existing frameworks of practice and thinking.

senses.definition_vi: một tập hợp các niềm tin, ý tưởng hoặc quy tắc được sử dụng làm cơ sở để đưa ra các phán xét, quyết định, v.v.

senses.definition: the structure of a particular system

examples.x: the basic framework of society
a regulatory/legislative framework
We need to establish a legal framework for the protection of the environment.

senses.definition_vi: cấu trúc của một hệ thống cụ thể

senses.definition: formal permission given by a company to somebody who wants to sell its goods or services in a particular area; formal permission given by a government to somebody who wants to operate a public service as a business

examples.x: a franchise agreement/company
a catering/rail franchise
In the reorganization, Southern Television lost their franchise.
to operate a business under franchise

senses.definition_vi: sự cho phép chính thức của một công ty đối với người muốn bán hàng hóa hoặc dịch vụ của công ty đó tại một khu vực cụ thể; sự cho phép chính thức của chính phủ đối với người muốn điều hành một dịch vụ công cộng dưới dạng kinh doanh

senses.definition: a business or service run under franchise

examples.x: They operate franchises in London and Paris.
He's got a job as manager of a burger franchise.
He runs a local pizza franchise.

senses.definition_vi: một doanh nghiệp hoặc dịch vụ được điều hành theo hình thức nhượng quyền

senses.definition: the right to vote in a country’s elections

examples.x: universal adult franchise
The 1918 Reform Act extended the franchise to women over 30.

senses.definition_vi: quyền bỏ phiếu trong các cuộc bầu cử của một quốc gia

senses.definition: a set of films in which the same characters appear in related stories

examples.x: Disney has successfully revived the ‘Star Wars’ franchise, with four films already released and more in the works.

senses.definition_vi: một loạt phim mà cùng các nhân vật xuất hiện trong các câu chuyện liên quan

senses.definition: in an honest and direct way that people might not like

examples.x: He spoke frankly about the ordeal.
They frankly admitted their responsibility.

senses.definition_vi: một cách trung thực và trực tiếp mà mọi người có thể không thích

senses.definition: used to show that you are being honest about something, even though people might not like what you are saying

examples.x: Frankly, I couldn't care less what happens to him.
Quite frankly, I'm not surprised you failed.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy bạn đang trung thực về một điều gì đó, ngay cả khi mọi người có thể không thích những gì bạn đang nói

senses.definition: the crime of cheating somebody in order to get money or goods illegally

examples.x: She was charged with credit card fraud.
It was said that the property had been obtained by fraud.
He helped prevent a $100 million fraud.

senses.definition_vi: tội lừa đảo ai đó để lấy tiền hoặc hàng hóa một cách bất hợp pháp

senses.definition: a person who pretends to have qualities, abilities, etc. that they do not really have in order to cheat other people

examples.x: He's nothing but a liar and a fraud.
She felt a fraud accepting their sympathy (= because she was not really sad).

senses.definition_vi: người giả vờ có những phẩm chất, khả năng, v.v. mà họ thực sự không có để lừa gạt người khác

senses.definition: something that is not as good, useful, etc. as people claim it is
senses.definition_vi: thứ gì đó không tốt, không hữu ích, v.v. như mọi người tuyên bố

senses.definition: without particular plans or arrangements; not busy

examples.x: Are you free on Saturday? We're having a barbecue.
We try to keep Sundays free.
If Sarah is free for lunch I'll take her out.
Keep Friday night free for my party.
What do you like to do in your free time (= when you are not working)?

senses.definition_vi: không có kế hoạch hoặc sắp xếp cụ thể; không bận

senses.definition: not being used

examples.x: He held out his free hand and I took it.
Is this seat free?

senses.definition_vi: không được sử dụng

senses.definition: costing nothing

examples.x: Admission is free.
free software/tickets
We even offer a free web design service.
We''ll give you a fabulous free gift with each copy you buy.
Use of the pool is free to members.
Updates are free for registered users.
You can't expect people to work for free (= without payment).

senses.definition_vi: không tốn kém

senses.definition: not under the control or in the power of somebody else; able to do what you want

examples.x: I have no ambitions other than to have a happy life and be free.
Students have a free choice of modules in their final year.
You are free to leave at any time.
The government wants to leave companies free to make their own decisions.
The organization wants to remain free from government control.
We want an independent state free of foreign interference.
‘Can I sit here?’ ‘Please, feel free (= of course you can).’
Feel free to email me if you have any questions.

senses.definition_vi: không bị ai đó kiểm soát hoặc nằm trong quyền lực của người khác; có thể làm những gì bạn muốn

senses.definition: not limited or controlled by anyone else

examples.x: A true democracy needs free speech and a free press.
He called for free and fair elections.
They gave me free access to all the files.

senses.definition_vi: không bị giới hạn hoặc kiểm soát bởi bất kỳ ai khác

senses.definition: not a prisoner or slave

examples.x: He walked out of jail a free man.
The hostages were all set free.
The hacker is currently free on bail.

senses.definition_vi: không phải là tù nhân hoặc nô lệ

senses.definition: not tied up or in a cage

examples.x: The researchers set the birds free.
Our livestock is free to roam.

senses.definition_vi: không bị buộc dây hoặc nhốt trong lồng

senses.definition: clear; not blocked

examples.x: Ensure there is a free flow of air around the machine.
the free movement of traffic

senses.definition_vi: rõ ràng; không bị chặn

senses.definition: not containing or affected by something harmful or unpleasant

examples.x: free from artificial colours and flavourings
Everyone deserves to live free from fear.
free of defects/problems/symptoms
Beef producers want their herds free of disease.
It was several weeks before he was completely free of pain.
We've managed to keep the garden free of weeds this year.

senses.definition_vi: không chứa hoặc bị ảnh hưởng bởi thứ gì đó có hại hoặc khó chịu

senses.definition: without the thing mentioned

examples.x: pure, additive-free ingredients
a trouble-free life
After six months of treatment he is cancer-free.

senses.definition_vi: không có thứ được đề cập

senses.definition: not attached to something; not stuck somewhere and unable to move

examples.x: Pull gently on the free end of the rope.
She finally managed to pull herself free.
They tied him up but he managed to get free.
They had to be cut free from their car after the accident.
The boat had broken free of its moorings.
They swam free of the wreckage.

senses.definition_vi: không gắn liền với thứ gì đó; không bị kẹt ở đâu đó và không thể di chuyển

senses.definition: ready to give something, especially when it is not wanted

examples.x: He's too free with his opinions.

senses.definition_vi: sẵn sàng cho đi thứ gì đó, đặc biệt là khi nó không được mong muốn

senses.definition: a free translation is not exact but gives the general meaning
senses.definition_vi: bản dịch tự do không chính xác nhưng đưa ra ý nghĩa chung

senses.definition: to have done something successfully, especially when it was difficult

examples.x: I could see the finish line and thought I was home free.

senses.definition_vi: đã làm xong điều gì đó thành công, đặc biệt là khi nó khó khăn

senses.definition: informal; relaxed

examples.x: Life was never going to be so free and easy again.

senses.definition_vi: thông tục; thư giãn

senses.definition: if you give somebody a free pass or somebody gets a free pass, they are not punished for something bad they have done, or they are given permission to do something bad

examples.x: This time he gets a free pass but if he does it again, he’ll be sent to jail.
Just because someone has expensive designer gear, it doesn't mean they have a free pass to be mean to my staff.

senses.definition_vi: thẻ miễn trừ hoặc ai đó nhận được thẻ miễn trừ, họ sẽ không bị phạt vì điều gì đó tồi tệ họ đã làm, hoặc họ được phép làm điều gì đó tồi tệ

senses.definition: to get, have, etc. the opportunity to do what you want to do and to make your own decisions

examples.x: I was given a free hand in designing the syllabus.

senses.definition_vi: có được, có, v.v. cơ hội làm những gì bạn muốn làm và đưa ra quyết định của riêng bạn

senses.definition: to get or take something without paying because somebody else is paying for it
senses.definition_vi: nhận hoặc lấy thứ gì đó mà không phải trả tiền vì người khác đang trả tiền cho nó

senses.definition: to give somebody complete freedom of action; to allow a feeling to be expressed freely

examples.x: The designer was given free rein.
The script allows full rein to her larger-than-life acting style.
When I paint I just give my imagination free rein.

senses.definition_vi: cho ai đó hoàn toàn tự do hành động; cho phép một cảm xúc được thể hiện một cách tự do

senses.definition: used as a reply when somebody suggests that you should not do something, or when somebody has asked permission or said they are going to do something

examples.x: It's a free country; I'll say what I like!
Wear what you like. It's a free country.
‘It's a free country!’ he shouted. ‘I can do what I like!’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng như một câu trả lời khi ai đó gợi ý rằng bạn không nên làm điều gì đó, hoặc khi ai đó đã xin phép hoặc nói rằng họ sẽ làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that it is not possible to get something for nothing
senses.short_meaning_vi: không có gì là miễn phí
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng không thể có được thứ gì đó mà không phải trả giá

senses.definition: to be allowed to leave court, etc., without receiving any punishment

examples.x: She was acquitted and walked free from court.

senses.definition_vi: được phép rời khỏi tòa án, v.v., mà không bị phạt

senses.definition: without payment

examples.x: Children under five travel free.
We will send you our booklet free of charge.

senses.definition_vi: không phải trả tiền

senses.definition: in a way that is not tied but is able to move about

examples.x: Attach the top and let the ends hang free.
He yanked the door hard, and at last it swung free.
Her long hair hung free down her back.

senses.definition_vi: theo cách không bị buộc chặt nhưng có thể di chuyển xung quanh

senses.definition: to use something a lot, even though it does not belong to you

examples.x: Does she know that you're making free with her belongings?

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng thứ gì đó nhiều, ngay cả khi nó không thuộc về bạn

senses.definition: to be allowed to go where it likes; not tied to anything or kept in a cage

examples.x: Horses should be able to run free on large plots of land.

senses.definition_vi: được phép đi đến nơi nó thích; không bị buộc vào bất cứ thứ gì hoặc bị nhốt trong lồng

senses.definition: to allow somebody to leave prison or somewhere they have been kept against their will

examples.x: The hijackers agreed to free a further ten hostages.
By the end of May nearly 100 of an estimated 2 000 political prisoners had been freed.
She led an operation that freed 70 trafficked workers.
They succeeded in freeing their friends from prison.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó rời khỏi tù hoặc nơi họ bị giam giữ trái với ý muốn

senses.definition: to move somebody/something that is caught or fixed on something

examples.x: She struggled to free herself.
A good kick finally freed the door.
Three people were freed from the wreckage.
He managed to free his arms from their bonds.

senses.definition_vi: di chuyển ai đó/thứ gì đó đang bị mắc kẹt hoặc cố định trên thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to remove something that is unpleasant or not wanted from somebody/something

examples.x: These exercises help free the body of tension.
The police are determined to free the town of violent crime.
The centre aims to free young people from dependency on drugs.

senses.definition_vi: loại bỏ thứ gì đó khó chịu hoặc không mong muốn khỏi ai đó/thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to make somebody/something available for a particular purpose

examples.x: We freed time each week for a project meeting.
The government has promised to free up more resources for education.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó/thứ gì đó có sẵn cho một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: to give somebody the extra time to do something that they want to do

examples.x: Winning the prize freed him to paint full-time.
Using the content management software frees up staff.

senses.definition_vi: cho ai đó thêm thời gian để làm điều gì đó mà họ muốn làm

senses.definition: the power or right to do or say what you want without anyone stopping you

examples.x: Press freedom is under attack.
All groups enjoyed religious freedom.
As a society we value personal freedom and privacy.
We just want freedom of choice.
Everyone has the right to freedom of expression.
freedom of conscience/thought/worship
The government continues to restrict freedom of movement.
Enjoy the freedom of the outdoors (= where you can do what you want).
rights and freedoms guaranteed by the constitution
complete freedom to do as you wish
These proposals would give health authorities greater freedom in deciding how to spend their money.

senses.definition_vi: quyền hoặc khả năng làm hoặc nói những gì bạn muốn mà không ai ngăn cản bạn

senses.definition: the state of not being a prisoner or slave

examples.x: He finally won his freedom after twenty years in jail.
Many slaves who gained their freedom lost it again after the war.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái không phải là tù nhân hoặc nô lệ

senses.definition: the state of not being ruled by a foreign or cruel government

examples.x: We believe in freedom and democracy.
He was a champion of Irish freedom.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái không bị cai trị bởi chính phủ nước ngoài hoặc tàn bạo

senses.definition: the state of being able to move easily

examples.x: The skirt has a side split for freedom of movement.
Free-range hens have greater freedom to move about.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái có thể di chuyển dễ dàng

senses.definition: the state of not being affected by the thing mentioned

examples.x: All people should be guaranteed freedom from fear.
freedom from discrimination based on gender or ethnicity
freedom from pain and disease

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái không bị ảnh hưởng bởi thứ được đề cập

senses.definition: permission to use something without limits

examples.x: I was given the freedom of the whole house.

senses.definition_vi: sự cho phép sử dụng thứ gì đó mà không có giới hạn

senses.definition: the chance to change the way that something happens and influence decisions that are made

examples.x: Small farmers have limited room for manoeuvre.

senses.definition_vi: cơ hội để thay đổi cách mọi thứ xảy ra và ảnh hưởng đến các quyết định được đưa ra

senses.definition: without anyone trying to prevent or control something

examples.x: the country’s first freely elected president
EU citizens can travel freely between member states.
the right to worship freely
Prices are higher than they would be if market forces were allowed to operate freely.

senses.definition_vi: mà không ai cố gắng ngăn cản hoặc kiểm soát điều gì đó

senses.definition: without anything stopping the movement or flow of something

examples.x: When the gate is raised, the water can flow freely.
Traffic is now moving more freely following an earlier accident.
The book is now freely available in the shops (= it is not difficult to get a copy).
Once into the open street they could breathe more freely.
The wine flowed freely (= there was a lot of it to drink).

senses.definition_vi: mà không có gì cản trở sự di chuyển hoặc dòng chảy của một thứ gì đó

senses.definition: in an honest way without worrying about what people will say or do

examples.x: For the first time he was able to speak freely without the fear of reprisals against his family.

senses.definition_vi: một cách trung thực mà không lo lắng về những gì mọi người sẽ nói hoặc làm

senses.definition: without trying to avoid the truth even though it might be unpleasant or embarrassing

examples.x: I freely admit that I made a mistake.
Both players freely acknowledge that money was a major incentive.

senses.definition_vi: mà không cố gắng tránh sự thật ngay cả khi nó có thể khó chịu hoặc đáng xấu hổ

senses.definition: in a willing and generous way

examples.x: Millions of people gave freely in response to the appeal for the victims of the earthquake.
She has always given freely of her time.

senses.definition_vi: một cách sẵn lòng và hào phóng

senses.definition: a piece of writing that is translated freely is not translated exactly but the general meaning is given
senses.definition_vi: một đoạn văn được dịch thoáng nghĩa là không dịch chính xác nhưng truyền đạt ý nghĩa chung

senses.definition: to become hard, and often turn to ice, as a result of extreme cold; to make something do this

examples.x: Water freezes at 0°C.
It's so cold that even the river has frozen.
The cold weather had frozen the ground.
The clothes froze solid on the washing line.
The frost had frozen the ground hard.
Last year's cold spell froze the lake solid.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên cứng, và thường biến thành băng, do lạnh giá; làm cho cái gì đó như vậy

senses.definition: if a pipe, lock or machine freezes, or something freezes it, it becomes blocked with frozen liquid and therefore cannot be used

examples.x: The pipes have frozen, so we've got no water.
I kept the car running to stop the engine freezing up.
Ten degrees of frost had frozen the lock on the car.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một đường ống, ổ khóa hoặc máy bị đóng băng, hoặc thứ gì đó làm nó đóng băng, nó sẽ bị tắc nghẽn bởi chất lỏng đã đóng băng và do đó không thể sử dụng được

senses.definition: when it freezes, the weather is at or below 0° Celsius

examples.x: It may freeze tonight, so bring those plants inside.

senses.definition_vi: khi trời đóng băng, thời tiết ở mức 0°C hoặc thấp hơn

senses.definition: to be very cold; to be so cold that you die

examples.x: Every time she opens the window we all freeze.
Two men froze to death on the mountain.
Two men were frozen to death on the mountain.

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy rất lạnh; lạnh đến chết

senses.definition: to keep something, especially food, at a very low temperature in order to preserve it

examples.x: Can you freeze this cake?
The organ samples were immediately frozen in liquid nitrogen.

senses.definition_vi: giữ một thứ gì đó, đặc biệt là thực phẩm, ở nhiệt độ rất thấp để bảo quản

senses.definition: to be able to be kept at a very low temperature

examples.x: Some fruits freeze better than others.

senses.definition_vi: có thể được giữ ở nhiệt độ rất thấp

senses.definition: to stop moving suddenly because of fear, etc.

examples.x: I froze with terror as the door slowly opened.
The smile froze on her lips.
The police officer shouted ‘Freeze!’ and the man dropped the gun.
Suddenly, Ronny seemed to freeze.
He was so surprised he froze to the spot.
Maggie's face had frozen into a cold mask.
She froze with horror when she saw the body.

senses.definition_vi: dừng di chuyển đột ngột vì sợ hãi, v.v.

senses.definition: when a computer screen freezes, you cannot move any of the images, etc. on it, because there is a problem with the system
senses.definition_vi: khi màn hình máy tính bị treo, bạn không thể di chuyển bất kỳ hình ảnh nào, v.v. trên đó, vì có sự cố với hệ thống

senses.definition: to stop a film or video in order to look at a particular picture

examples.x: Freeze the action there!

senses.definition_vi: dừng một bộ phim hoặc video để xem một hình ảnh cụ thể

senses.definition: to hold wages, prices, etc. at a fixed level for a period of time

examples.x: Salaries have been frozen for the current year.
Prices have been frozen at this level for over a year now.

senses.definition_vi: giữ tiền lương, giá cả, v.v. ở một mức cố định trong một khoảng thời gian

senses.definition: to prevent money, a bank account, etc. from being used by getting a court order which bans it

examples.x: The company's assets have been frozen.

senses.definition_vi: ngăn chặn tiền, tài khoản ngân hàng, v.v. được sử dụng bằng cách nhận lệnh của tòa án cấm nó

senses.definition: to make you extremely frightened or shocked
senses.definition_vi: làm cho bạn cực kỳ sợ hãi hoặc sốc

senses.definition: to suddenly stop because something has frightened or surprised you

examples.x: Jess froze in her tracks and took a deep breath.

senses.definition_vi: dừng đột ngột vì điều gì đó đã làm bạn sợ hãi hoặc ngạc nhiên

senses.definition: to suddenly make somebody stop by frightening or surprising them; to suddenly stop because something has frightened or surprised you

examples.x: The question stopped Alice in her tracks.
Suddenly he stopped dead in his tracks: what was he doing?
The disease was stopped in its tracks by immunization programmes.

senses.definition_vi: đột ngột làm ai đó dừng lại vì điều gì đó đã làm họ sợ hãi hoặc ngạc nhiên; đột ngột dừng lại vì điều gì đó đã làm họ sợ hãi hoặc ngạc nhiên

senses.definition: the rate at which something happens or is repeated

examples.x: Fatal road accidents have decreased in frequency over recent years.
Dawn was then visiting New York with increasing frequency.
a society with a high/low frequency (= happening often/not very often) of stable marriages
Users will be able to rearrange their icons by frequency of use.
The program can show us word frequency (= how often words occur in a language).

senses.definition_vi: tốc độ mà một cái gì đó xảy ra hoặc lặp lại

senses.definition: the fact of something happening often

examples.x: the alarming frequency of computer errors
The relative frequency of this illness in the area is of concern to all doctors.
Objects like this turn up at sales with surprising frequency.
Bullets bounced off the rock with alarming frequency.

senses.definition_vi: việc một cái gì đó xảy ra thường xuyên

senses.definition: the rate at which a sound or electromagnetic wave vibrates (= moves up and down)

examples.x: a high/low frequency
Electromagnetic waves of radio frequency can make molecules vibrate and heat up.

senses.definition_vi: tốc độ mà một âm thanh hoặc sóng điện từ rung động (= di chuyển lên xuống)

senses.definition: the number of radio waves for every second of a radio signal

examples.x: a frequency band
an FM radio frequency
There are only a limited number of broadcasting frequencies.

senses.definition_vi: số lượng sóng vô tuyến cho mỗi giây của tín hiệu vô tuyến

senses.definition: happening or doing something often

examples.x: He is a frequent visitor to this country.
Her calls became less frequent.
There is a frequent bus service into the centre of town.
How frequent is this word (= how often does it occur in the language)?

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc làm điều gì đó thường xuyên

senses.definition: often

examples.x: Buses run frequently between the city and the airport.
some of the most frequently asked questions about celebrities
It was a word he used frequently.
Her father, a pilot, was frequently absent from home.

senses.definition_vi: thường xuyên

senses.definition: recently produced or picked and not frozen, dried or preserved in tins or cans

examples.x: Is this milk fresh?
fresh bread/flowers/fish
Eat plenty of fresh fruit and vegetables.
Our chefs use only the freshest produce available.
vegetables fresh from the garden
Doesn't fruit taste a lot better fresh off the tree?

senses.definition_vi: vừa mới sản xuất hoặc hái và chưa bị đông lạnh, sấy khô hoặc bảo quản trong hộp hoặc lon

senses.definition: pleasantly clean, pure or cool

examples.x: a toothpaste that leaves a nice fresh taste in your mouth
Let's go and get some fresh air (= go outside where the air is cooler).
Her hair smelled fresh and newly washed.
Horses should have fresh, clean water available at all times.

senses.definition_vi: sạch sẽ, tinh khiết hoặc mát mẻ một cách dễ chịu

senses.definition: made or experienced recently

examples.x: fresh tracks in the snow
a fresh wound
Let me write it down while it's still fresh in my mind.
The war is too recent and the memories are too fresh.
The park looks wonderful under a blanket of fresh snow.

senses.definition_vi: vừa mới được thực hiện hoặc trải nghiệm

senses.definition: new or different in a way that adds to or replaces something

examples.x: a fresh coat of paint
Could we order some fresh coffee?
The defence have found fresh evidence that could form the basis of an appeal.
This is the opportunity he needs to make a fresh start (= to try something new after not being successful at something else).
The government is said to be taking a fresh look at the matter.
The kids bring a wealth of fresh ideas with them.
I think it's time we tried a fresh approach.

senses.definition_vi: mới hoặc khác biệt theo cách bổ sung hoặc thay thế một cái gì đó

senses.definition: containing no salt

examples.x: There is a shortage of fresh water on the island.

senses.definition_vi: không chứa muối

senses.definition: quite strong and cold

examples.x: a fresh breeze
The winds are likely to get fresher towards the end of the day.

senses.definition_vi: khá mạnh và lạnh

senses.definition: quite cold with some wind

examples.x: It's fresh this morning, isn't it?

senses.definition_vi: khá lạnh với một chút gió

senses.definition: looking clear, bright and attractive

examples.x: He looked fresh and neat in a clean white shirt.
a collection of summer dresses in fresh colours
a fresh complexion

senses.definition_vi: trông sạch sẽ, tươi sáng và hấp dẫn

senses.definition: full of energy

examples.x: Regular exercise will help you feel fresher and fitter.
I managed to sleep on the plane and arrived feeling as fresh as a daisy.

senses.definition_vi: đầy năng lượng

senses.definition: having just come from a particular place; having just had a particular experience

examples.x: students fresh out of college
fresh from her success at the Olympic Games
The singer is fresh off a successful world tour.

senses.definition_vi: vừa mới đến từ một địa điểm cụ thể; vừa mới có một trải nghiệm cụ thể

senses.definition: rude and too confident in a way that shows a lack of respect for somebody or a sexual interest in somebody

examples.x: Don't get fresh with me!

senses.definition_vi: thô lỗ và quá tự tin theo cách thể hiện sự thiếu tôn trọng đối với ai đó hoặc sự quan tâm tình dục đối với ai đó

senses.definition: clean air breathed in after being indoors or in a dirty atmosphere

examples.x: We'll get a breath of fresh air at lunchtime.
I'm going outside for a breath of fresh air.

senses.definition_vi: không khí sạch được hít vào sau khi ở trong nhà hoặc trong bầu không khí ô nhiễm

senses.definition: a person, thing or place that is new and different and therefore interesting and exciting

examples.x: The new secretary is a breath of fresh air.

senses.definition_vi: một người, vật hoặc địa điểm mới và khác biệt, do đó thú vị và hấp dẫn

senses.definition: new members or employees, especially young ones, with new ideas or ways of doing things

examples.x: This company badly needs to bring in some fresh blood.

senses.definition_vi: các thành viên hoặc nhân viên mới, đặc biệt là những người trẻ, với những ý tưởng hoặc cách làm việc mới

senses.definition: to make somebody feel positive, especially when they thought that they had no chance of achieving something
senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy tích cực, đặc biệt là khi họ nghĩ rằng mình không có cơ hội đạt được điều gì đó

senses.definition: the day of the week after Thursday and before Saturday

examples.x: It's Friday today, isn't it?
She went to dance class last Friday.
Are you busy next Friday?
Friday morning/afternoon/evening
We'll discuss this at Friday's meeting.
I work Friday to Tuesday.
I work Fridays to Tuesdays.
We'll meet on Friday (= next Friday).
We met on Friday (= last Friday).
We'll meet Friday.
The museum is closed on Fridays (= every Friday).
The museum is closed Fridays.
He was born on a Friday.
I always do yoga on a Friday (= every Friday).
I went to Nairobi on Monday, and came back the following Friday.
‘When did the accident happen?’ ‘It was the Friday (= the Friday of the week we are talking about).’
Come back Friday week (= a week after next Friday).

senses.definition_vi: ngày trong tuần sau Thứ Năm và trước Thứ Bảy

senses.definition: a character in Daniel Defoe's novel Robinson Crusoe. He becomes Crusoe's faithful servant after Crusoe saves him from being eaten by cannibals. The phrase Man Friday or Girl Friday was sometimes used to describe an assistant who did many different jobs in an office, but is now quite old-fashioned.
senses.definition_vi: một nhân vật trong tiểu thuyết Robinson Crusoe của Daniel Defoe. Anh ta trở thành người hầu trung thành của Crusoe sau khi Crusoe cứu anh ta khỏi bị ăn thịt bởi thổ dân. Cụm từ Man Friday hoặc Girl Friday đôi khi được dùng để mô tả một trợ lý làm nhiều công việc khác nhau trong văn phòng, nhưng giờ đây đã khá lỗi thời.

senses.definition: a piece of electrical equipment in which food is kept cold so that it stays fresh

examples.x: The kids tend to raid the fridge when they get home from school.
There's no food in the fridge!

senses.definition_vi: một thiết bị điện dùng để giữ thực phẩm lạnh để nó tươi lâu

senses.definition: a person you know well and like, and who is not usually a member of your family

examples.x: This is my friend Tom.
Is he a friend of yours?
Jane's a friend of the family.
She's an old friend (= I have known her a long time).
He's one of my best friends.
a close/good/dear friend
a childhood/family/longtime friend
We've been friends for years.
They had a quarrel, but they're friends again now.
to become/remain friends
I'm asking you as a friend not to tell anyone.
She wanted to share the news with family and friends.
She has a wide circle of friends.
I heard about it through a friend of a friend.

senses.definition_vi: một người mà bạn biết rõ và thích, và thường không phải là thành viên gia đình bạn

senses.definition: a person who is on your list of contacts on a social media website

examples.x: How many friends have you got on Facebook?
Facebook friends

senses.definition_vi: một người có trong danh sách liên hệ của bạn trên trang web mạng xã hội

senses.definition: a person who supports an organization, a charity, etc., especially by giving or raising money; a person who supports a particular idea, etc.

examples.x: the Friends of St Martin’s Hospital
a friend of democracy
Theatre tickets are 10% cheaper for Friends.

senses.definition_vi: một người ủng hộ một tổ chức, một tổ chức từ thiện, v.v., đặc biệt là bằng cách quyên góp hoặc gây quỹ; một người ủng hộ một ý tưởng, v.v. cụ thể.

senses.definition: a person who has the same interests and opinions as yourself, and who will help and support you

examples.x: His eyes were moving from face to face: friend or foe?
You're among friends here—you can speak freely.

senses.definition_vi: một người có cùng sở thích và quan điểm với bạn, và sẽ giúp đỡ và hỗ trợ bạn

senses.definition: used to talk about or to somebody that you meet who is not actually a friend

examples.x: I wish our friend at the next table would shut up.
My friends, let me introduce myself.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói về hoặc với ai đó mà bạn gặp, người không thực sự là bạn bè

senses.definition: used by a member of parliament to refer to another member of parliament or by a lawyer to refer to another lawyer in a court of law

examples.x: my honourable friend, the member for Henley (= in the House of Commons)
my noble friend (= in the House of Lords)
my learned friend (= in a court of law)

senses.definition_vi: thành viên quốc hội dùng để chỉ một thành viên quốc hội khác hoặc luật sư dùng để chỉ một luật sư khác trong tòa án

senses.definition: a member of the Society of Friends
senses.definition_vi: một thành viên của Hội bạn hữu

senses.definition: used to say that two friends are not having a romantic relationship with each other

examples.x: They gradually got to know each other better but they remained just good friends.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng hai người bạn không có mối quan hệ lãng mạn với nhau

senses.definition: a friend who gives you help when you need it (is a true friend)
senses.definition_vi: một người bạn giúp đỡ bạn khi bạn cần (là một người bạn thực sự)

senses.definition: to know important people who can help you

examples.x: ‘How did he get promoted so quickly?’ ‘Oh, he has friends in high places.’

senses.definition_vi: biết những người quan trọng có thể giúp bạn

senses.definition: to become a friend of somebody

examples.x: Simon finds it hard to make friends with other children.

senses.definition_vi: trở thành bạn của ai đó

senses.definition: a way of describing a dog
senses.definition_vi: một cách mô tả một con chó

senses.definition: behaving in a kind and pleasant way because you like somebody or want to help them

examples.x: a warm and friendly person
The bar is great and the staff are friendly.
Everyone was very friendly towards me.
I'm sure that the people are friendlier to strangers in Romania.

senses.definition_vi: cư xử một cách tử tế và dễ chịu vì bạn thích ai đó hoặc muốn giúp đỡ họ

senses.definition: showing that somebody is kind; making you feel relaxed and as though you are among friends

examples.x: a friendly smile/welcome
a friendly gesture/greeting
a small hotel with a friendly atmosphere
Instantly I felt at home with her big smile and friendly face.
This is a very friendly neighbourhood.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện rằng ai đó tốt bụng; làm cho bạn cảm thấy thư giãn và như thể bạn đang ở giữa bạn bè

senses.definition: treating somebody as a friend

examples.x: We soon became friendly with the couple next door.
She was on friendly terms with most of the hospital staff.
We were not on the friendliest of terms (= we were not friendly at all).

senses.definition_vi: đối xử với ai đó như một người bạn

senses.definition: not treating somebody/something as an enemy

examples.x: to maintain friendly relations with all countries

senses.definition_vi: không đối xử với ai đó/cái gì đó như kẻ thù

senses.definition: that is helpful and easy to use; that helps somebody/something or does not harm it

examples.x: This software is much friendlier than the previous version.
child-friendly policies
Without a doubt, friendly bacteria are essential for good health.

senses.definition_vi: hữu ích và dễ sử dụng; giúp đỡ ai đó/cái gì đó hoặc không gây hại cho nó

senses.definition: in which people are not arguing or competing in a serious or unpleasant way

examples.x: a friendly argument
friendly rivalry
The tournament always sparks some friendly banter about who is the best nation.

senses.definition_vi: trong đó mọi người không tranh cãi hoặc cạnh tranh một cách nghiêm túc hoặc khó chịu

senses.definition: not part of an important competition

examples.x: It was only a friendly match.

senses.definition_vi: không phải là một phần của cuộc thi quan trọng

senses.definition: a relationship between friends

examples.x: They formed a close friendship at college.
a lasting/lifelong friendship
to forge/develop/cultivate a friendship
He seemed to have already struck up (= begun) a friendship with Jo.
It's the story of an extraordinary friendship between a boy and a seal.

senses.definition_vi: một mối quan hệ giữa bạn bè

senses.definition: the feeling or relationship that friends have; the state of being friends

examples.x: Your friendship is very important to me.
a conference to promote international friendship
It was largely out of friendship for him that I agreed to come to Turin.

senses.definition_vi: làm hoặc đạt được những gì đã được hy vọng hoặc mong đợi

senses.definition: to do or have what is required or necessary

examples.x: to fulfil a duty/an obligation/a promise
to fulfil the terms/conditions of an agreement
No candidate fulfils all the criteria for this position.
He had fulfilled his promise to his father.
Once they had fulfilled their obligations, they were allowed to go.
Failure to fulfil the terms of the agreements may result in legal action.
Work permits are only given to people who fulfil certain criteria.

senses.definition_vi: làm hoặc có những gì được yêu cầu hoặc cần thiết

senses.definition: to have a particular role or purpose

examples.x: Nursery schools should fulfil the function of preparing children for school.

senses.definition_vi: có một vai trò hoặc mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: to make somebody feel happy and satisfied with what they are doing or have done

examples.x: I need a job that really fulfils me.
He was able to fulfil himself through his painting.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy hạnh phúc và hài lòng với những gì họ đang làm hoặc đã làm

senses.definition: to pack and send something that a customer has ordered

examples.x: We aim to fulfil all orders within seven days.
Huge demand led to customers waiting weeks to see their orders finally fulfilled.

senses.definition_vi: đóng gói và gửi những gì khách hàng đã đặt

senses.definition: containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space

examples.x: a full bottle of wine
She could only nod, because her mouth was full.
The theatre was less than half full.
My suitcase was full of books.
There were cardboard boxes stuffed full of clothes.
Sorry, the hotel is full up tonight.

senses.definition_vi: chứa hoặc giữ được nhiều nhất có thể; không có khoảng trống

senses.definition: having or containing a large number or amount of something/somebody

examples.x: The sky was full of brightly coloured fireworks.
The gallery was full of people.
He's always full of energy.
She was so bubbly and full of life.
Life is full of coincidences.
Our new brochure is crammed full of inspirational ideas.
She was full of admiration for the care she had received.
He smiled, his eyes full of laughter.

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc chứa một số lượng lớn hoặc nhiều thứ/người

senses.definition: having had enough to eat

examples.x: No more for me, thanks—I'm full up.
The kids still weren't full, so I gave them an ice cream each.
You can't run on a full stomach.

senses.definition_vi: đã ăn đủ

senses.definition: complete; with nothing missing

examples.x: Full details are available on request.
They sell a full range of hair and beauty products.
I still don't think we've heard the full story.
a full English breakfast
Fill in your full name and address.
It is too early to assess the full extent of the damage.
Frank is expected to make a full recovery.
A full refund will be given if the item is faulty.

senses.definition_vi: hoàn chỉnh; không thiếu gì

senses.definition: to the highest level or greatest amount possible

examples.x: Many people don't use their computers to their full potential.
measures to achieve full employment
Students should take full advantage of the university's facilities.
She came round the corner at full speed.

senses.definition_vi: ở mức cao nhất hoặc lượng lớn nhất có thể

senses.definition: busy; involving a lot of activities

examples.x: He'd had a very full life.
Her life was too full to find time for hobbies.
We went to bed exhausted after a very full day.

senses.definition_vi: bận rộn; liên quan đến nhiều hoạt động

senses.definition: thinking or talking a lot about a particular thing

examples.x: He was full of his new job and everything he'd been doing.

senses.definition_vi: suy nghĩ hoặc nói nhiều về một điều gì đó cụ thể

senses.definition: used to emphasize an amount or a quantity

examples.x: She is a full four inches shorter than her sister.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh một lượng hoặc một số lượng

senses.definition: appearing as a complete circle

examples.x: The moon was full, the sky clear.

senses.definition_vi: xuất hiện dưới dạng một vòng tròn hoàn chỉnh

senses.definition: large and round. ‘Full’ is sometimes used to avoid saying ‘fat’.

examples.x: He kissed her full sensual lips.
They specialize in clothes for women with a fuller figure.

senses.definition_vi: lớn và tròn. ‘Full’ đôi khi được dùng để tránh nói ‘fat’ (béo).

senses.definition: made with plenty of cloth; fitting loosely

examples.x: a full skirt

senses.definition_vi: làm bằng nhiều vải; vừa vặn lỏng lẻo

senses.definition: deep, strong and rich

examples.x: He draws a unique full sound from the instrument.
the full fruity flavour of the coffee

senses.definition_vi: sâu, mạnh và đậm đà

senses.definition: not telling the truth; tending to make things seem better, worse or more important than they actually are

examples.x: ‘You are so full of it!’ she retorted furiously.

senses.definition_vi: không nói sự thật; có xu hướng làm cho mọi thứ có vẻ tốt hơn, tệ hơn hoặc quan trọng hơn so với thực tế

senses.definition: very proud; thinking only of yourself
senses.definition_vi: rất tự hào; chỉ nghĩ về bản thân

senses.definition: including the whole of something

examples.x: The address must be printed in full.

senses.definition_vi: bao gồm toàn bộ một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to the greatest possible degree

examples.x: I've always believed in living life to the full.

senses.definition_vi: ở mức độ lớn nhất có thể

senses.definition: completely

examples.x: I fully understand your motives.
She never fully recovered from the accident.
She fully supports her daughter's plans.
We are fully aware of the dangers.
The classrooms are fully equipped.
Everyone cooperated fully with the investigation.

senses.definition_vi: một cách hoàn chỉnh

senses.definition: the whole of; as much as

examples.x: The disease affects fully 30 per cent of the population.

senses.definition_vi: toàn bộ; nhiều nhất có thể

senses.definition: that you enjoy

examples.x: She's really fun to be with.
a film that's great fun to watch
This game looks fun!
Let's have a fun night out.
There are lots of fun things for young people to do here.

senses.definition_vi: mà bạn thích

senses.definition: that provides entertainment or leisure activities

examples.x: a family fun day

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp hoạt động giải trí hoặc thời gian rảnh rỗi

senses.definition: the feeling of enjoying yourself; activities that you enjoy

examples.x: We had a lot of fun at Sarah's party.
Sailing is good fun.
It was great fun! You should have come too.
That was the most fun I have had in years.
Have fun! (= Enjoy yourself)
‘What fun!’ she said with a laugh.
We won't let a bit of rain spoil our fun.
I decided to learn Spanish, just for fun.
I didn't do all that work just for the fun of it.
It's not much fun going to a party on your own.
It's no fun getting up at 4  a.m. on a cold, rainy morning.
Walking three miles in the pouring rain is not my idea of fun.
The whole family can join in the fun at Water World.
‘What do you say to a weekend in New York?’ ‘Sounds like fun.’

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác tận hưởng bản thân; các hoạt động mà bạn thích

senses.definition: behaviour or activities that are not serious but are meant to be enjoyed

examples.x: She's very lively and full of fun.
We didn't mean to hurt him. It was just a bit of fun.
You have to have a sense of fun to be a good teacher.
It wasn't serious—it was all done in fun.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi hoặc hoạt động không nghiêm túc nhưng nhằm mục đích để được hưởng thụ

senses.definition: to be/become somebody that other people laugh at
senses.definition_vi: trở thành người mà người khác cười nhạo

senses.definition: activities that are not serious and that other people may think are bad

examples.x: Teaching isn't all fun and games, you know.

senses.definition_vi: các hoạt động không nghiêm túc và có thể bị người khác cho là xấu

senses.definition: to laugh at somebody/something or make other people laugh at them, usually in an unkind way

examples.x: It's cruel to make fun of people who stammer.

senses.definition_vi: cười nhạo ai đó/cái gì đó hoặc làm cho người khác cười nhạo họ, thường là một cách không thân thiện

senses.definition: to say unkind things about somebody/something in order to make other people laugh at them

examples.x: Her novels poke fun at the upper class.
She’s always poking fun at herself.

senses.definition_vi: nói những điều không hay về ai đó/cái gì đó để làm cho người khác cười nhạo họ

senses.definition: a special activity or purpose of a person or thing

examples.x: The club serves a useful function as a meeting place.
to fulfil/perform a function
What is your function in the department?
bodily functions (= for example eating, sex, using the toilet)
The function of the heart is to pump blood through the body.
This design aims for harmony of form and function.

senses.definition_vi: một hoạt động hoặc mục đích đặc biệt của một người hoặc một vật

senses.definition: a social event or official ceremony

examples.x: The hall provided a venue for weddings and other functions.
The couple attended a charity function in aid of cancer research.

senses.definition_vi: một sự kiện xã hội hoặc buổi lễ chính thức

senses.definition: a quantity whose value depends on the varying values of others. In the statement 2x=y, y is a function of x.

examples.x: Salary is a function of age and experience.

senses.definition_vi: một đại lượng có giá trị phụ thuộc vào các giá trị thay đổi của các đại lượng khác. Trong biểu thức 2x=y, y là một hàm số của x.

senses.definition: a part of a program, etc. that performs a basic operation
senses.definition_vi: một phần của chương trình, v.v. thực hiện một hoạt động cơ bản

senses.definition: to work in the correct way

examples.x: We now have a functioning shower.
Despite the power cuts, the hospital continued to function normally.
Many children can't function effectively in large classes.
I can't function properly without a coffee.

senses.definition_vi: hoạt động đúng cách

senses.definition: practical and useful; with little or no decoration

examples.x: Bathrooms don't have to be purely functional.
The office was large and functional rather than welcoming.
Items such as musical instruments may be both functional and aesthetically pleasing.

senses.definition_vi: thực tế và hữu ích; ít hoặc không có trang trí

senses.definition: having a special purpose; making it possible for somebody to do something or for something to happen

examples.x: a functional disorder (= an illness caused when an organ of the body fails to perform its function)
a functional approach to language learning
These units played a key functional role in the military operation.

senses.definition_vi: có một mục đích đặc biệt; làm cho ai đó có thể làm gì đó hoặc điều gì đó có thể xảy ra

senses.definition: working; able to work

examples.x: The hospital will soon be fully functional.

senses.definition_vi: đang hoạt động; có khả năng hoạt động

senses.definition: an amount of money that has been saved or has been made available for a particular purpose

examples.x: a disaster relief fund
the company’s pension fund
the International Monetary Fund
There is currently over $200 000 in the fund.

senses.definition_vi: một khoản tiền đã được tiết kiệm hoặc đã được cung cấp cho một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: money that is available to be spent

examples.x: government/federal funds
The hospital is trying to raise funds for a new kidney machine.
to provide/use funds for something
More funds should be allocated to housing.
The project has been cancelled because of lack of funds.
I'm short of funds at the moment—can I pay you back next week?

senses.definition_vi: tiền có sẵn để chi tiêu

senses.definition: a company that manages money for people by investing it; the money managed by such a company

examples.x: Any extra money that James saves should go into a money market fund.
She is a fund manager for an Asian bank.

senses.definition_vi: một công ty quản lý tiền cho mọi người bằng cách đầu tư nó; số tiền được quản lý bởi một công ty như vậy

senses.definition: an amount or a supply of something

examples.x: a fund of knowledge

senses.definition_vi: một lượng hoặc nguồn cung cấp của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to provide money for something, usually something official

examples.x: Who is funding this research?
to fund a project/study/scheme
It's a government-funded programme for young offenders.
publicly funded healthcare
a federally funded housing project
The museum is privately funded.
The festival is funded by a grant from the Arts Council.
It is important that these training placements are fully funded.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp tiền cho một cái gì đó, thường là một cái gì đó chính thức

senses.definition: serious and very important; affecting the most central and important parts of something

examples.x: the fundamental principles of scientific method
You have a fundamental right to privacy.
a fundamental question/problem/issue
a question of fundamental importance
This principle is absolutely fundamental.
There is a fundamental difference between the two points of view.
A fundamental change in the organization of health services was required.

senses.definition_vi: nghiêm trọng và rất quan trọng; ảnh hưởng đến các phần trung tâm và quan trọng nhất của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: central; forming the necessary basis of something

examples.x: Hard work is fundamental to success.
Low interest rates are fundamental for growth.

senses.definition_vi: trung tâm; tạo thành cơ sở cần thiết của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: forming the source or base from which everything else is made; not able to be divided any further

examples.x: a fundamental particle

senses.definition_vi: tạo thành nguồn hoặc cơ sở từ đó mọi thứ khác được tạo ra; không thể chia nhỏ hơn nữa

senses.definition: in every way that is important; completely

examples.x: The two approaches are fundamentally different.
By the 1960s the situation had changed fundamentally.
They remained fundamentally opposed to the plan.

senses.definition_vi: theo mọi cách quan trọng; hoàn toàn

senses.definition: used when you are introducing a topic and stating something important about it

examples.x: Fundamentally, there are two different approaches to the problem.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang giới thiệu một chủ đề và nêu lên một điều quan trọng về nó

senses.definition: used when you are saying what is the most important thing about somebody/something

examples.x: She is fundamentally a nice person, but she finds it difficult to communicate.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang nói điều gì là quan trọng nhất về ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: money for a particular purpose; the act of providing money for such a purpose

examples.x: federal/state funding
There have been large cuts in government funding for scientific research.
Alex originally struggled to secure funding for the project.
to receive/get/obtain funding for something
to provide/allocate funding for something
to withdraw/cut funding for something

senses.definition_vi: tiền cho một mục đích cụ thể; hành động cung cấp tiền cho mục đích như vậy

senses.definition: the activity of collecting money for a charity or organization, often by organizing social events or entertainments

examples.x: The hospice is planning a major fundraising event for June.

senses.definition_vi: hoạt động thu tiền cho một tổ chức từ thiện hoặc tổ chức, thường bằng cách tổ chức các sự kiện xã hội hoặc giải trí

senses.definition: a ceremony, often a religious one, for burying or cremating (= burning) a dead person

examples.x: Hundreds of people attended the funeral.
a funeral procession
a funeral march (= a sad piece of music suitable for funerals)

senses.definition_vi: một buổi lễ, thường là tôn giáo, để chôn cất hoặc hỏa táng (= đốt) người đã khuất

senses.definition: used to tell somebody that they, and nobody else, will have to deal with the unpleasant results of their own actions
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói với ai đó rằng họ, và không ai khác, sẽ phải đối mặt với những hậu quả khó chịu từ hành động của chính họ

senses.definition: making you laugh

examples.x: a funny story/joke
He was a very funny guy as well as a kind person.
That's the funniest thing I've ever heard.
The movie is full of funny moments.
I found the play funny and moving.
It's not funny! Someone could have been hurt.
I was really embarrassed, but then I saw the funny side of it.
Oh very funny! You expect me to believe that?
‘What's so funny?’ she demanded.

senses.definition_vi: làm bạn cười

senses.definition: difficult to explain or understand; strange and not as you expect

examples.x: A funny thing happened to me today.
It's funny how things never happen the way you expect them to.
That's funny—he was here a moment ago and now he's gone.
The funny thing is it never happened again after that.
The engine's making a very funny noise.
I'm pleased I didn't get that job, in a funny sort of way.
This tea tastes funny.

senses.definition_vi: khó giải thích hoặc khó hiểu; kỳ lạ và không như bạn mong đợi

senses.definition: seeming or likely to be wrong, illegal or dishonest

examples.x: I suspect there may be something funny going on.
If there has been any funny business, we'll soon find out.

senses.definition_vi: có vẻ hoặc có khả năng sai, bất hợp pháp hoặc không trung thực

senses.definition: humorous in a way that shows a lack of respect for somebody

examples.x: Don't you get funny with me!

senses.definition_vi: hài hước theo cách thể hiện sự thiếu tôn trọng đối với ai đó

senses.definition: slightly ill

examples.x: I feel a bit funny today—I don't think I'll go to work.

senses.definition_vi: hơi ốm

senses.definition: slightly crazy or strange

examples.x: That Dave's a funny chap, isn't he?

senses.definition_vi: hơi điên hoặc kỳ lạ

senses.definition: not working as it should

examples.x: My computer keeps going funny.

senses.definition_vi: không hoạt động như nó nên

senses.definition: used to show that ‘funny’ is being used with the meaning of ‘making you laugh’
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra rằng 'funny' đang được sử dụng với ý nghĩa 'làm bạn cười'

senses.definition: used to show that ‘funny’ is being used with the meaning of ‘strange’
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra rằng 'funny' đang được sử dụng với ý nghĩa 'kỳ lạ'

senses.definition: the soft thick mass of hair that grows on the body of some animals

examples.x: The cat carefully licked its fur.
She stroked the soft fur on the dog's back.

senses.definition_vi: khối lông mềm dày mọc trên cơ thể một số động vật

senses.definition: the skin of an animal with the fur still on it, used especially for making clothes

examples.x: a fur coat
the fur trade
a fur farm (= where animals are bred and killed for their fur)
fur-lined gloves
The animal is hunted for its fur.
Many models refuse to wear fur on the runway.

senses.definition_vi: da của động vật còn nguyên lông, đặc biệt dùng để làm quần áo

senses.definition: an artificial material that looks and feels like fur
senses.definition_vi: một vật liệu nhân tạo trông và có cảm giác giống lông thú

senses.definition: a piece of clothing, especially a coat or jacket, made of real or artificial fur

examples.x: elegant ladies in furs
She was wearing her fur.

senses.definition_vi: một món quần áo, đặc biệt là áo khoác hoặc áo jacket, làm bằng lông thú thật hoặc giả

senses.definition: a hard grey-white substance that is sometimes left inside water pipes and containers for heating water
senses.definition_vi: một chất màu xám trắng cứng đôi khi còn lại bên trong đường ống nước và các bộ phận chứa để làm nóng nước

senses.definition: a grey-white layer that forms on a person’s tongue, especially when they are ill
senses.definition_vi: một lớp màu xám trắng hình thành trên lưỡi người, đặc biệt là khi họ bị ốm

senses.definition: very angry

examples.x: Their incompetence made me furious.
She was absolutely furious at having been deceived.
He was furious with himself for letting things get so out of control.
I'm furious that I wasn't told about it.

senses.definition_vi: rất tức giận

senses.definition: with great energy, speed or anger

examples.x: a furious debate
She drove off at a furious pace.
A furious row broke out last night after it was revealed that hundreds of prisoners had been released early from jail.
Play was fast and furious in the opening minutes of the game.

senses.definition_vi: với năng lượng, tốc độ hoặc sự tức giận lớn

senses.definition: objects that can be moved, such as tables, chairs and beds, that are put into a house or an office to make it suitable for living or working in

examples.x: garden/office furniture
a dealer in antique furniture
a piece of furniture
We need to buy some new furniture.

senses.definition_vi: các vật dụng có thể di chuyển được, như bàn, ghế và giường, được đặt trong nhà hoặc văn phòng để làm cho nó phù hợp để sinh sống hoặc làm việc

senses.definition: a person or thing that you are so used to seeing that you no longer notice them

examples.x: I worked there so long that I became part of the furniture.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật mà bạn đã quá quen nhìn thấy đến nỗi bạn không còn để ý đến họ nữa

senses.definition: more; additional

examples.x: Cook for a further 2 minutes.
For further details call this number.
Can you give me any further information?
further investigation/research/study/analysis
This week provided further evidence of an unfolding global energy crisis.
No further developments have been reported.
We have decided to take no further action.
The museum is closed until further notice (= until we say that it is open again).

senses.definition_vi: nhiều hơn; bổ sung

senses.definition: at or to a greater distance

examples.x: We had walked a bit further than I had realized.
I'm too tired to go any further.
further north/south/east/west
Two miles further on we came to a small town.
The hospital is further down the road.
Can you stand a bit further away?

senses.definition_vi: ở hoặc đến một khoảng cách xa hơn

senses.definition: a longer way in the past or the future

examples.x: Think further back into your childhood.
How will the company be doing ten years further on?

senses.definition_vi: một chặng đường dài hơn trong quá khứ hoặc tương lai

senses.definition: to a greater degree or extent

examples.x: to develop/increase/enhance/improve something further
to strengthen/support something further
Costs must be further reduced.
The police decided to investigate further.
My life is further complicated by having to work such long hours.
She was getting further and further into debt.
Nothing could be further from the truth.
Their share price fell further today.

senses.definition_vi: ở mức độ hoặc phạm vi lớn hơn

senses.definition: in addition to what has just been said

examples.x: Further, it is important to consider the cost of repairs.

senses.definition_vi: ngoài những gì vừa được nói

senses.definition: far away from home; to or in places that are not near

examples.x: You can hire a car if you want to explore further afield.
People commute to London from as far afield as France.

senses.definition_vi: xa nhà; đến hoặc ở những nơi không gần

senses.definition: to say more about something, or make a more extreme point about it

examples.x: I would go even further and suggest that the entire government is corrupt.

senses.definition_vi: nói thêm về điều gì đó, hoặc đưa ra một điểm cực đoan hơn về nó

senses.definition: to last longer; to serve more people

examples.x: They watered down the soup to make it go further.

senses.definition_vi: kéo dài hơn; phục vụ nhiều người hơn

senses.definition: if you tell somebody that a secret will go no further, you promise not to tell it to anyone else
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói với ai đó rằng một bí mật sẽ không đi xa hơn, bạn hứa sẽ không nói nó cho bất kỳ ai khác

senses.definition: used to say that something is exactly what somebody needs and so they do not need to consider any other options

examples.x: Those looking for an enjoyable evening need look no further than the hotel's nightclub.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng một cái gì đó chính xác là những gì ai đó cần và do đó họ không cần xem xét các lựa chọn khác

senses.definition: to take more serious action about something or speak to somebody at a higher level about it

examples.x: I am not satisfied with your explanation and intend to take the matter further.

senses.definition_vi: thực hiện hành động nghiêm túc hơn về một vấn đề hoặc nói chuyện với ai đó ở cấp cao hơn về nó

senses.definition: in addition to what has just been stated. Furthermore is used especially to add a point to an argument.

examples.x: He said he had not discussed the matter with her. Furthermore, he had not even contacted her.

senses.definition_vi: ngoài những gì vừa được nêu. Hơn nữa được sử dụng đặc biệt để thêm một điểm vào một lập luận.

senses.definition: taking place or existing at a time after the present

examples.x: The land will remain untouched for future generations to enjoy.
The reasons for the decision will be announced at a future date.
future developments in artificial intelligence
present and future trends in industry
the ability to anticipate possible future events
She told us about her future plans.
He met his future wife at law school.
I wrote down the name of the hotel for future reference (= because it might be useful in the future).

senses.definition_vi: diễn ra hoặc tồn tại vào một thời điểm sau hiện tại

senses.definition: the time that will come after the present or the events that will happen then

examples.x: We need to plan for the future.
The movie is set in the future.
at some point/time in the future
I don't expect any of these things to happen in the near future (= soon).
Things will continue as they are for the foreseeable future.
the immediate/not-too-distant/long-term/distant future
Nobody can predict the future.
What does the future hold?
What will the cities of the future look like?
Kevin talked about his hopes for the future.

senses.definition_vi: thời gian sẽ đến sau hiện tại hoặc các sự kiện sẽ xảy ra sau đó

senses.definition: what will happen to somebody/something at a later time

examples.x: The company faces a very uncertain future.
We must seize the opportunity to shape our future.
This deal could secure the futures of 2  000 employees.
to decide/determine the future of somebody/something
Recent events throw doubt on the president’s political future.

senses.definition_vi: điều gì sẽ xảy ra với ai đó/cái gì đó vào một thời điểm sau đó

senses.definition: the possibility of being successful or surviving at a later time

examples.x: They have a bright future ahead of them.
I can't see any future in this relationship.
There's no future in mining in this country.
Children are the future of this country (= the country's future depends on children).

senses.definition_vi: khả năng thành công hoặc tồn tại vào một thời điểm sau này

senses.definition: goods or shares that are bought at agreed prices but that will be delivered and paid for at a later time

examples.x: oil futures
the futures market

senses.definition_vi: hàng hóa hoặc cổ phiếu được mua với giá đã thỏa thuận nhưng sẽ được giao và thanh toán vào một thời điểm sau này

senses.definition: the form of a verb that expresses what will happen after the present
senses.definition_vi: hình thức của động từ diễn tả những gì sẽ xảy ra sau hiện tại

senses.definition: for/in the period of time when you can predict what is going to happen, based on the present circumstances

examples.x: The statue will remain in the museum for the foreseeable future.
It's unlikely that the hospital will be closed in the foreseeable future (= soon).

senses.definition_vi: trong/vào khoảng thời gian mà bạn có thể dự đoán những gì sẽ xảy ra, dựa trên hoàn cảnh hiện tại

senses.definition: from now on

examples.x: Please be more careful in future.
In future, make sure the door is never left unlocked.

senses.definition_vi: từ bây giờ trở đi

senses.definition: not a long time in the future but fairly soon

examples.x: I hope we’ll see each other again in the not too distant future.

senses.definition_vi: không còn lâu nữa trong tương lai nhưng khá sớm

senses.definition: not modern; no longer fashionable

examples.x: old-fashioned clothes/styles/methods/equipment
These sweets are still made in the old-fashioned way.
The Winnedumah Hotel has old-fashioned charm.
His clothes were curiously old-fashioned.
Critics regarded her films as hopelessly old-fashioned.
The whole room looked old-fashioned.
The hotel is quaint and old-fashioned.

senses.definition_vi: không hiện đại; không còn hợp thời trang

senses.definition: believing in old or traditional ways; having traditional ideas

examples.x: My parents are old-fashioned about relationships and marriage.
She wants to be an old-fashioned mother, staying at home and looking after the children.
Call me old-fashioned, but I still believe in good manners.
She's somewhat old-fashioned in her attitudes.
He seemed too old-fashioned and formal.

senses.definition_vi: tin vào những cách cũ hoặc truyền thống; có những ý tưởng truyền thống

senses.definition: simple, traditional and good quality

examples.x: At heart, it's just a good old-fashioned detective story.
What's needed is some good old-fashioned common sense.

senses.definition_vi: đơn giản, truyền thống và chất lượng tốt
